## 5.1.11. Karvannan

*kār vaṇṇan kaṇṇa pirān kamalat tadam kaṇṇan tannai ēr vaḷa oṇkaḻanik kurugūrc catakōpan sonna sīr vaṇṇa oṇ tamiḻgaḷ ivai āyirattuḷ ippattum ār vaṇṇattāl uraippār adik kīḻ puguvār polindē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kaṇṇan – appearing as kriṣṇa; pirān – great benefactor; kār – invigorating like a dark cloud; vaṇṇan – having form; kamalam – like a lotus flower; tadam – wide; kaṇṇan tannai – one who is having eyes; ēr – ploughs; vaḷam – having abundance; oṇ – best; kaḻani – having fields; kurugūr – leader of āḻvārtirunagari; satakōpan – nammāḻvār; sonna – mercifully spoke; sīr – poetic measurement; vaṇṇam – having candas (meter); oṇ – good, due to revealing the meanings clearly; tamiḻgaḷ – in drāvida (tamiḻ) language; ivai – these; āyirattuḷ – among the thousand pāsurams; ippattum – this decad; Ar vaṇṇattāl – like those who drink nectar; uraippār – who can recite; polindu – having flourishing nature, form and qualities; adik kīḻ – the divine feet of kriṣṇa; puguvār – will attain

**Перевод:**

**nammāḻvār , the leader of āḻvārtirunagari, which is having abundance of ploughs and best fields, mercifully spoke about emperumān, the great benefactor, appearing as kriṣṇa, who is having invigorating form like that of a dark cloud, who is having lotus flower like wide eyes, in this decad among the thousand pāsurams which are having poetic measurement and meter and are in good drāvida (tamiḻ) language, due to revealing the meanings clearly; those who can recite this decad like drinking nectar, will have flourishing nature, form and qualities, and will attain the divine feet of kriṣṇa. It can also be said as – one who recites this with desire, will reach the divine feet of kriṣṇa.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the end, āḻvār says “Those who are experts in this decad, will have infinite śrīvaiṣṇavaśrī (wealth of kainkaryam) and attain emperumān‘s divine feet”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says “Those who are experts in this decad, will have well established wealth in svarūpa (true nature), rūpa (form) and guṇa (qualities), and attain kriṣṇa’s divine feet”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kār vaṇṇan kaṇṇa pirān kamalat tadam kaṇṇan tannai ēr vaḷa oṇkaḻanik kurugūrc catakōpan sonna sīr vaṇṇa oṇ tamiḻgaḷ ivai āyirattuḷ ippattum Ar vaṇṇattāl uraippār adik kīḻ puguvār polindē*

- *kār vaṇṇan* – One who is having a form like a dark cloud which is invigorating.
- *kaṇṇa pirān* – Appearing as kriṣṇa, and who allowed me enjoy that form.
- *kamalat tadam kaṇṇan tannai* – Having divine eyes which are cool and fresh like a pond with well blossomed lotus flowers. It appears that [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s eyes fill his whole form. [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) is explaining the form which was shown to console him previously as in [tiruvāimoḻi 5.1.6](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2017/05/thiruvaimozhi-5-1-6-puramara/) “*niṟamudai nāl tadam tōḷ*“. When āḻvār became fearful thinking about his own bodily connection, emperumān glanced with his cool eyes, manifesting his invigorating form and presenting himself fully to āḻvār – explaining such state.
- *ēr vaḷa oṇ kaḻani* – tirunagari which has abundance of ploughs and beautiful fields. vaḷam indicates abundance and beauty. Here it is focussing on abundance.
- *sīr vaṇṇa oṇ tamiḻgaḷ* – Beautiful tamiḻ with best structure. Another explanation – beautiful tamiḻ with the aspects of poems such as structure and meter. sīr is one aspect of the poem. vaṇṇam – sound/meter.
- *Ar vaṇṇattāl* – Complete. Another explanation – ārdal means drinking, as said in “*toṇḍarkkamuduṇṇa*” (to be drunk as nectar by devotees), those who drink these pāsurams; that is, those who recite it with great desire.
- *polindē adik kīḻ puguvār* – Unlike reciting just with confidence of reaching the goal and without the real taste; instead, like [emperumānār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/emperumanar/), living for 100 years with śrīvaiṣṇavaśri. Subsequently will enter the divine feet of emperumān like taking shelter at mother’s comfort.

## 5.2 Poliga poliga

## 5.2.1. Poliga poliga

*poliga poliga poliga pōyiṟṟu valluyirc cābam naliyum naragamum nainda namanukkingiyādonṟumillai kaliyum kedum kaṇḍu koṇmin kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ maṇ mēl maliyap pugundisai pādi ādi uḻi tarak kaṇḍōm*

**Пословный перевод:**

kadal – like an attractive ocean, which is containing precious gems inside it; vaṇṇan – by sarvēśvaran who has greatness due to having distinguished qualities and form; būdangaḷ – those who were reformed to become bhāgavatas (who are sustained by bhagavān); maṇ mēl – in this earth (which is contrary to enjoying bhagavān’s qualities); maliya – to be present in abundance; pugundu – entered; isai – with music; pādi – sing; ādi – (out of great joy) dance, with their heads heading the ground; uḻi tara – to engage everywhere; kaṇḍōm – we have seen; val uyirc cābam – very strong curses in the form of ignorance etc, which are unnatural for the ātmā, and which can be exhausted by experiencing the results; pōyiṟṟu – have been destroyed; naliyum – that which tortures due to such avidyā, karma etc; naragamum – narakams (hellish regions); nainda – are broken; namanukku – for yama, who controls such hellish regions; ingu – in this material realm; yādu – to be controlled; onṟum – anything; illai – not present; kaliyum – the defect of the times \[kaliyuga\], which is the cause for all these aforementioned; kedum – will be destroyed; kaṇḍu koṇmin – as said in “kalau kruta yugantasya“, see for yourself that this occurred by the presence of bhāgavatas who engage in virtuous activities from the times of kruta yuga; poliga poliga poliga – let this become more abundant!

**Перевод:**

**We have seen those who were reformed to become bhāgavatas by sarvēśvaran who has greatness due to having distinguished qualities and form like an attractive ocean, which is containing precious gems inside it, entered this earth to be present in abundance, sing with music, dance and engage everywhere; thus, very strong curses in the form of ignorance etc, which are unnatural for the ātmā, and which can be exhausted by experiencing the results have been destroyed; narakams which torture due to such avidyā, karma etc, are broken; and thus, there was nothing present to be controlled by yama who controls such hellish regions; the defect of the times \[kaliyuga\], which is the cause for all the aforementioned aspects, will also be destroyed. As said in “kalau kruta yugantasya“, see for yourself that this occurred by the presence of bhāgavatas who engage in virtuous activities from the times of kruta yuga; let this become more abundant! Following śruti (vēdam) which says “śāntiś śāntiś śānti:“, here too, “poliga” is repeated thrice. Since bhūta is a gender neutral word, it indicates “ahṟiṇai” (in tamiḻ, animals, plants and non-living things are considered as ahṟiṇai, and celestial beings and humans are considered as uyartiṇai).**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the first pāsuram, āḻvār seeing the abundance of śrīvaiṣṇavas, performs mangaḷāśāsanam (well wishes) to them.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār seeing the abundance of bhāgavatas who are sustained by sarvēśvaran, performs mangaḷāśāsanam to them.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. poliga poliga poliga pōyiṟṟu valluyirc cābam naliyum naragamum nainda namanukkingiyādonṟumillai kaliyum kedum kaṇḍu koṇmin kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ maṇ mēl maliyap pugundisai pādi ādi uḻi tarak kaṇḍōm*

- *poliga poliga poliga* – Let this become abundant! Let this become abundant! Let this become abundant! As in “*śāntiś śāntiś śānti:*” (Peace! Peace! Peace!), mangaḷāśāsanams (well wishes) done according to vaidika method, will be done in repetition of thrice. When asked “Should [nammāḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) also not perform mangaḷāśāsanam first to [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) and then to bhāgavatas, as done by [periyāḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/periyazhwar/) \[in [tiruppallāṇḍu](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2015/06/thiruppallandu/)\]?”, nanjīyar mercifully explained “Yes – In ‘*vīṟṟirundu ēḻulagu*‘, āḻvār performed mangaḷāśāsanam to bhagavān and now he is performing mangaḷāśāsanam to bhāgavatas”. periyāḻvār is following the footsteps of nammāḻvār who is paramācārya (the supreme ācārya).
- *pōyiṟṟu val uyirc cābam* – The hard śāpa (curse) for the ātmā, left. pāpa (sin) is called śāpa (curse) since as one who is cursed will have to go through the effects, here too, those who have sins, need to exhaust them by experiencing the results of them. The avidyā (ignorance) etc which have affected the ātmā have gone now.
- *naliyum naragamum nainda* – Even the naraka (hellish regions) where the cētanas, based on their karma, are brought and tortured, have been broken. Since there is no one to be handled in naraka, it fell into ruins.

When asked “What did the controllers of those places do?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *namanukku ingu yādu onṟum illai* – yama too can go and search in paramapadam \[for his own upliftment\], since he has nothing to do in the places where he was in charge.
- *yādu onṟum illai* – Even darmaputra (yudiśtra) had to visit hell once \[not to suffer for punishment, but just as a visit\], there is none present even for such visits.

When asked “But this is the situation in kruta yugam \[the first of the four yugams, when everyone is very pious\]; would this happen in kali yugam \[the last yugam, when impious nature is rampant?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *kaliyum kedum* – Even that kali will be destroyed. First explanation – Whatever explained previously may be explained in the context of past, and this highlighting of [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/), i.e., “*kedum*“,  may be explained in the context of future. Another explanation – “*kedum*” is explained as present, highlighting that the bad times are already over and we are seeing the good times already.

When asked “How can you say this while kali yugam is happening?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *kaṇḍu koṇmin* – Do I need to instruct explicitly for what can be personally experienced by you?

When asked “How are you saying that, this \[sufferings\] will end?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ* – All these sufferings occur due to absence of bhāgavatas, and once they exist and start moving around, will these sufferings remain? “*yatra aśtākśara samsidda*: … *na tatra sancariśyanti …*”  (In those places where those bhāgavatas who are faithful towards tirumantram reside, there will be no disease, famine and robbery).
- *kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ* – Since the root for the word “*bhū*” indicates “that which exists \[based on [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s existence'”, here bhāgavatas are indicated by the word “*būtangaḷ*” (bhūtams). bhāgavatas constantly remember bhagavān’s invigorating form and sustain themselves.

When asked “īsn’t it in paramapadam, where we find those who are captivated by his beauty?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *maṇ mēl* – āḻvār specifically highlights saying “right here”.

When asked “Is it like finding an oasis (water body) in a desert, we are finding one or two bhāgavatas in this samsāram (where devotion to [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) is difficult to acquire)?”, āḻvār says,

- *maliyap pugundu* – As said in [tiruvāimoḻi 2.3.10](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2016/02/thiruvaimozhi-2-3-10-kalippum-kavarvum/) “*adiyārgaḷ kuḻāngaḷ*” (Groups of devotees), arriving in crowds.
- *isai pādi* … – We have seen them out of great joy singing, dancing wildly and walking over the head of yama et al. *uḻitarugai* – roaming around freely without any fear.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.2. Kandom kandom

*kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm kaṇṇukkiniyana kaṇḍōm toṇḍīr elleerum vārīr toḻudu toḻudu ninṟārttum vaṇḍār taṇṇam tuḻāyān mādavan būdangaḷ maṇmēl paṇ tān pādi ninṟādip parandu tiriginṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

vaṇḍu – by beetles; Ar – fully; taṇ am – having freshness; tuḻāyān – wearing tiruttuḻāy (tuḷasi) garland; mā – for lakshmi who enjoys such beauty; davan – for sarvēśvara who is the beloved lord; būdangaḷ – servitors; maṇ mēl – on this earth (which does not have anyone qualified to enjoy such aspect); paṇ tān – to have abundance of tune; ninṟu – stood; pādi – sang; ādi – danced (out of overwhelming love); parandu – spreading out everywhere; tiriginṟana – engaged; kaṇṇukku – for our eyes; iniyana – pleasing prosperity \[of śrīvaiṣṇavas and their activities\]; kaṇḍōm – we have seen; kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm – Not just seeing once but got to enjoy repeatedly as said thrice in “aham annāda:“\[jīvātmā imploring emperumān in śrīvaikuṇṭam to enjoy him repeatedly\]; toḻudu toḻudu – being overwhelmed with love, engaging in continuous worship; ninṟu – stood; ārttum – engaged in joyful celebrations; toṇḍīr – Oh those who are favourable towards bhagavān and bhāgavatas!; elleerum – all of you; vārīr – please come

**Перевод:**

**The servitors of sarvēśvaran who is the beloved lord of lakśmī, and who is wearing fresh tiruttuḻāy (tuḷasi) garland which is filled with beetles, stood on this earth and sang to increase the tune, danced and engaged in such activities by spreading out everywhere. We have seen this prosperity which is pleasing to the eyes; not just seeing once but got to enjoy repeatedly as said thrice in “aham annāda:“, being overwhelmed with love, engaging in continuous worship, and stood engaged in joyful celebrations. Oh those who are favourable towards bhagavān and bhāgavatas! All of you, please come.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the second pāsuram, seeing the abundance of śrīvaiṣṇavas, āḻvār says “All those who are favourable! please come to enjoy this prosperity”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, seeing bhāgavatas who are enjoying sarvēśvaran’s qualities such as śriyapatitvam (being the lord of śrī mahālakśmi) etc which highlight his supremacy, āḻvār is calling out to the favourable ones saying “Come and perform mangaḷāśāsanam”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm kaṇḍōm kaṇṇukkiniyana kaṇḍōm toṇḍīr elleerum vārīr toḻudu toḻudu ninṟārttum vaṇḍār taṇṇam tuḻāyān mādavan būdangaḷ maṇmēl paṇ tān pādi ninṟādip parandu tiriginṟavē*

- *kaṇḍōm* … – We have seen. Out of overwhelming love, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) is repeating it multiple times.
- *kaṇṇuku iniyana kaṇḍōm* – To eliminate all the pain of seeing abhāgavatas (those who are not bhāgavatas) as said in [tiruvāimoḻi 4.9.7](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2017/04/thiruvaimozhi-4-9-7-aye-ivvulagaththu/) “*kodu ulagam kāttēl*” (don’t show me this cruel material realm), we have seen the assembly of bhāgavatas.
- *toṇḍīr elleerum vārīr* – All of you who are interested in bhāgavata viśayam (matters related to bhāgavatas) who are described in periya tirumoḻi 7.4.4 “*pērāḷan pērōdum periyōrai orukālum pirigilēn*” (I will never separate even for a moment, from those great persons who recite the divine names of sarvēśvaran) assemble in groups here.

When asked “What is the purpose of inviting them?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *toḻudu toḻudu ninṟu ārttum* – Should we seek a goal for the goal? The goal is right there \[vorśipping in itself is the goal\]. By repetition, it is confirmed that that \[toḻudu – worship\] itself is the goal. ārttum – will joyfully celebrate.
- *vaṇḍār* … – [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) is having fresh tuḷasi garland which retains the beetles always, and is having greatness due to being śriya:pati (lord of [śrī mahālakśmi](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sri-mahalakshmi/)). śrīvaiṣṇavas who are captivated by such decoration and śriya:patitvam, in this material realm (which is inimical to enjoying [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)) instead of in paramapadam which is said as in [tiruvāimoḻi 4.9.10](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2017/04/thiruvaimozhi-4-9-10-kandu-kettu/) “*oṇḍodiyāḷ tirumagaḷum nīyumē*” (only you and śrī mahālkśmi who has thin waist), instead of being triggered by others but releasing their loving experience, themselves singing with great tunes, which make them dance and they spread out everywhere.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.3. Tiriyum kaliyugam

*tiriyum kali yugam nīngit tēvargaḷ tāmum pugundu periya kida yugam paṟṟip pērinba veḷḷam perugak kariya mugil vaṇṇan emmān kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ maṇ mēl iriyap pugundisai pādi engum idam koṇḍanavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

tiriyum – which changes the qualities of cētanas upside down; kali yugam – kali yugam; nīngi – to pass; dēvargaḷ – sūris (great personalities who have unfailing knowledge etc); tāmum – themselves; pugundu – enter; periya – growing/appearing to be a single yugam (so that the yuga sandhi (break) between different yugams is not observable); kida yugam – kruta yugam; paṟṟi – arrive; pērinba veḷḷam – unlimited ocean of joy which is caused by experiencing bhagavān; peruga – to increase more and more; kariya – blackish; mugil – enjoyable like a cloud; vaṇṇan – having a form; emmān – being my lord; kadal vaṇṇan – in the ocean of infinite qualities of sarvēsvaran’s; būdangaḷ – bhāgavatas who are immersed in qualities of such bhagavān; maṇ mēl – in this earth; iriya – to initiate the joyful celebrations; pugundu – enter; isai – songs; pādi – singing; engum – all regions; idam koṇḍana – took over as their residences

**Перевод:**

**kali yugam, which changes the qualities of cētanas upside down, passed and kruta yugam arrived without even the yuga sandhi, appearing to be a single yugam, when sūris \[dwellers of śrīvaikuṇṭam\] themselves enter; in such times, to increase more and more the unlimited ocean of joy which is caused by experiencing bhagavān, bhāgavatas who are immersed in  the qualities of sarvēśvaran who is having an enjoyable cloud-like blackish form, who is my lord and who is an ocean of infinite qualities, entered in this earth to initiate the joyful celebrations, singing songs and took over all regions as their residences.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the third pāsuram, āḻvār says “the whole samsāram is filled with vaiṣṇavas so that even ayaravaṟum amarargaḷ (nityasūris who are without any shortcoming), can enter and mingle here”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says “bhāgavatas who became immersed in the saundaryam (beauty) etc of sarvēśvaran who is having a divine form to satisfy his devotees, became well established in all regions to facilitate the engagement of great personalities of this material realm”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. tiriyum kali yugam nīngit tēvargaḷ tāmum pugundu periya kida yugam paṟṟip pērinba veḷḷam perugak kariya mugil vaṇṇan emmān kadal vaṇṇan būdangaḷ maṇ mēl iriyap pugundisai pādi engum idam koṇḍanavē*

- *tiriyum kali yugam nīngi* – As said in mahābhāratam mōkśa darmam “*na śruṇvanti pitu: putrā na snuśā na sahōdarā: na brutyā na kaḷatrāṇi bhaviśyati adarōttaram*” (In kali yugam, son will not obey father’s words, daughter-in-law will not obey mother-in-law’s words, younger brothers will not obey elder brother’s words, servants will not obey the master’s words), kali yugam, where the characteristics of the entities will turn around, ended. Alternative explanation – kali yugam where everything just goes and comes, ended.
- *dēvargaḷ tāmum pugundu* – indra et al who are the dēvatās of this realm; alternative explanation – nityasūris who cannot tolerate the odour of even such dēvas \[like indra et al\] and would vomit \[on seeing them\]. All such sūris would enter this realm without thinking that “this is samsāram \[material realm\]”.
- *periya kida yugam paṟṟi* – As if there is one long kruta yugam only, without the impact of other yugams such as kali yugam \[In this case, dēvas are in focus. That is, the dēvas who are attached to this long krut yugam\]. Alternative explanation – āppān explains “This is talking about the kruta yugam at the beginning of \[brahmā’s\] creation \[where sūris can enter\]”.
- *pērinba veḷḷam peruga* – To have the flood of joy, which is explained in tiruvāimoḻi 10.9.11 “*andamil pēṟinba*” (endless great joy), right here.
- *periya kida yugam paṟṟip pērinba veḷḷam peruga* – The flood of great joy increased starting with the first kruta yugam concealing the defects of the periods \[other yugams\] in between.
- *paṟṟi* – \[The period\] arrived to end kali yugam. ōr, to say that, \[the period\] arrived to start kruta yugam. \[Overall, paṟṟi is explained in three ways – “those who hold on to”, “starting” and “arriving”\]
- *kariya* … – Like [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) captivated me with his form which is explained in śrī rāmāyaṇam ayōdyā kāṇḍam 83.8 “*mēgaśyāmam*” (blackish cloud), those śrīvaiṣṇavas who are captivated by his invigorating form.
- *maṇ mēl iriyap pugundu* – In nitya vibhūti (paramapadam – spiritual realm), they \[nityasūris\] roam around with great celebrations. \[Similarly\] entered in this samsāram with great celebrations.
- *isai pādi* – Singing due to the joy which came about after enjoying [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/).
- *engum idam koṇḍanavē* – Had all regions as their abodes. The disciples and subsequent disciples \[of such bhāgavatas\] pervaded everywhere so that there is no space for bāhyas (those who reject vēdas) and kudruśtis (those who misinterpret vēdas). As said in śrī rāmāyaṇam yudda kāṇḍam 41.97 “*prakāram vānarīkrutam*” (The rākśasas saw the fort which was surrendered by monkeys, to be made of monkeys).

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.4. Idam kol

*idam koḷ samayattai ellām eduttuk kaḷaivana pōlē tadam kadal paḷḷip perumān tannudaip pūdangaḷēyāyk kidandum irundum eḻundum gītam pala pala pādi nadandum paṟandum kunittum nādagam seyginṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

idam koḷ – spreading everywhere (to bring down the presence of vaidika aspects); samayattai – bāhya \[not believing in vēdas\] philosophies such as baudda etc; ellām – all; eduttu – banishing; kaḷaivana pōlē – appearing to be; tadam – vast; kadal – in the ocean; paḷḷi – resting (for the sake of his devotees); perumān tannudai – those who are immersed in the qualities of the one who is greater than all; būdangaḷē – bhāgavatas themselves; āy – filled throughout the world; kidandum – lying down; irundum – sitting; eḻundum – standing; pala pala – many; gītam – songs; pādi – singing; nadandum – attractively roaming around; paṟandum – jumping/flying out of joy; kunittum – dancing, in this manner; nādagam – dramatic actions; seyginṟana – they are engaged

**Перевод:**

**bhāgavatas who are immersed in the qualities of emperumān who is resting in the vast \[milky\] ocean and is greater than all, are spreading everywhere appearing to be banishing all bāhya philosophies such as baudda etc and filled throughout the world; in those regions, they are engaged in dramatic actions such as lying down, sitting, standing, singing many songs, attractively roaming around, jumping/flying out of joy and dancing. This pāsuram is recited along with previous pāsuram \[to get the full meaning\].**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the fourth pāsuram, āḻvār says “vaiṣṇavas were present everywhere as if to uproot all the unśakeable bāhya philosophies and were singing, dancing and roaming around everywhere joyfully as a result of enjoying bhagavān“.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says “Those who are immersed in the auspicious qualities of the one who is reclining in the milky ocean and who is the benefactor for his devotees, are performing many joyful activities as if they are banishing the bāhya philosophies”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. idam koḷ samayattai ellām eduttuk kaḷaivana pōlē tadam kadal paḷḷip perumān tannudaip pūdangaḷēyāyk kidandum irundum eḻundum gītam pala pala pādi nadandum paṟandum kunittum nādagam seyginṟavē*

- *idam koḷ* … – Similar to weeds growing to suppress the growth of the crop, the bāhya philosophies which flourish pushing aside sātvikas (virtuous people) – appearing to be uprooting them. Why is it said “*pōlē*” (appearing to be)? sātvikas do not aim at troubling others. “*nel seyyap pul tēyumāp pōlē*” (as the crop is nurtured properly, the weeds will naturally disappear), as the devotees establish themselves, the others will naturally disappear.
- *tadam kadal paḷḷip perumān* … – śrīvaiṣṇavas who meditate upon the beauty of [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) who is reclining in tiruppāṟkadal (milky ocean) as said in tiruvāimoḻi 8.10.8 stretching his “*tāḷum tōḷum mudigaḷum*” (divine feet, shoulders and heads) and divinely resting, and recite as in periya tiruvantādi 34 “*pālāḻi nī kidakkum paṇbai yām kēttēyum kālāḻum nenjaḻiyum kaṇ suḻalum*” (as soon as I hear about your quality of resting in the milky ocean, my legs become weak, my heart melts and my eyes start spinning) and become immersed in that form.
- *kidandum* … – Having the earth to be at their disposal for their desired activities. Lying down in some places, sitting in other places, standing in yet other places, singing many songs out of great joy in experiencing [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/), roaming around to captivate the hearts of others, dancing in such a manner that their feet don’t touch the ground and so on.
- *nādagam seyginṟanavē* – For [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/), the activities of such bhāgavatas appear like that of an expert dancer’s dance. [nanjīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nanjiyar/) and others mercifully explain “as we would glorify [emperumānār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/emperumanar/)‘s existence, walking, resting etc, and as the king glorified [āḷavandār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/alavandhar/)‘s walk, āḻvār is glorifying the activities of these bhāgavatas”.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.5. Seyginradu

*seyginṟaden kaṇṇukkonṟē okkinṟadivvulagattu vaikundan būdangaḷēyāy māyattināl engum manni aiyam onṟillai arakkar asurar piṟandīr uḷḷīrēl uyyum vagai illai toṇḍīr ūḻi peyarttidum konṟē*

**Пословный перевод:**

seyginṟadu – their activities; en kaṇṇukku – for my eyes; onṟē okkinṟadu – it appears to be an astonishing one; ivvulagattu – in this world (where there are lots of unfavourable aspects); vaikundan – paramapadanātan’s; būdangaḷē – devotees who are enjoyers of \[paramapadanātan’s\] qualities, themselves; āy – became; māyattināl – by their amazing activities; engum – everywhere; manni – residing permanently; arakkar asurar – with demoniac and evil qualities; piṟandīr – those who are born; uḷḷīrēl – if present; toṇḍīr – Oh those who are interested in worldly pleasures!; konṟu – killing you; ūḻi – time period; peyarttidum – was changed; uyyum – redemption; vagai – way; illai – not there; aiyam – doubt; onṟum – any; illai – not there

**Перевод:**

**In this world, those who became paramapadanātan‘s devotees, who are enjoyers of \[paramapadanātan’s\] qualities, themselves, by their amazing activities, are residing permanently everywhere; oh those who are interested in worldly pleasures! oh those who are born with demoniac and evil qualities! if you are present, you will be killed and the \[bad\] times will change \[into good times\]; there is no way for your redemption; there is no doubt about this.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the fifth pāsuram, āḻvār says “Oh asuras (evil) and rākśasas (demons)! śrīvaiṣṇavas will finish you all and change the yugam too”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says to asuras and rākśasas “bhāgavatas who are immersed in the qualities of śrīvaikuṇṭanātan, will destroy you and you can no longer be redeemed”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*seyginṟaden kaṇṇukkonṟē okkinṟadivvulagattu vaikundan būdangaḷēyāy māyattināl engum manni aiyam onṟillai arakkar asurar piṟandīr uḷḷīrēl uyyum vagai illai toṇḍīr ūḻi peyarttidum konṟē*

- *seyginṟadu* … – When I saw whatever is happening, it appears to be something \[unique\] to my eyes. What is that? In this samsāram (material realm) which is inimical towards enjoying bhagavān’s qualities, there are śrīvaiṣṇavas who make us feel that we are in nitya vibhūti (paramapadam – spiritual realm).
- *māyattināl engum manni* – As said in nigaṇḍu (dictionary) “*māyā vayunam jñānam*” (māyā (amazing), vayunam (desire), jñānam (knowledge) are synonyms), with jñānam in the form of desire, they entered everywhere out of desire.
- *aiyam onṟu illai* – There is no doubt that “the śrīvaiṣṇavas live the vaikuṇṭha life right here”. Also explained as, there is no doubt that “the bad times will change into good times”.
- *arakkar* … – If those rākśasas and asuras assume human forms and try to enter like śuka and sāraṇa \[the servants of rāvaṇa\] entered śrī vānara sēnā (the divine monkey army),  there is no way for your redemption. Instead of having to search for perfect śrīvaiṣṇavas as in [tiruppallāṇḍu 3](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2015/06/thiruppallandu-3-vazhatpattu/) “*vāḻātpattu ninṟīr uḷḷīrēl*” (if you are engrossed in bhagavat kainkaryam and and stand firm in that *niśtai*), everyone became engrossed in kainkaryam, and thus ended up having to search if there are any rākśasas or asuras. This is how the whole samsāram became reformed after hearing [tiruvāimoḻi 4.10](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2017/04/thiruvaimozhi-4-10-onrum-dhevum/) “onṟum dēvum” decad.
- *toṇḍīr* – As said in manu smruti “*sēvāśvavrutti:*” (serving others, is dog’s job), you who all are serving worldly aspects, will be tortured \[and consumed\] by the time \[deluge\] and time will itself also change; alternative explanation – the devotees of vaikuṇṭanātan will destroy you all and also change the bad times into good times.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.6. Konruyir unnum

*konṟuyir uṇṇum visādi pagai pasi tīyana ellām ninṟivvulagil kadivān nēmip pirān tamar pōndār nanṟisai pādiyum tuḷḷi ādiyum jñālam parandār senṟu toḻuduymmin toṇḍīr sindaiyaic cenniṟuttiyē*

**Пословный перевод:**

konṟu – finishing the body; uyir – prāṇa (vital air); uṇṇum – consume; visādi – disease; pagai – enmity; pasi – hunger etc; tīyana – cruel nature; ellām – all; i – this; ulagil – in world; ninṟu – standing; kadivān – to destroy; nēmi – having the weapon, chakra (disc); pirān – sarvēśvaran‘s; tamar – servitors; pōndār – being; nanṟu – distinguished; isai – songs; pādiyum – sing; tuḷḷi – joyfully jump; ādiyum – dance; jñālam – all over the world; parandār – spread out; toṇḍīr – Oh fickle minded ones (who consider dēvatāntaram (other dēvatās) and viśayāntaram (worldly matters) as the goal and enjoyable aspect)!; sindaiyai – your heart which is focussed on external matters; sem – perfectly; niṟutti – placing it; senṟu – approaching (them); toḻudu – engaging in activities which match the quality of servitude; uymmin – see that you are saved

**Перевод:**

**sarvēśvaran is standing in this world, having the weapon, chakra (disc), to destroy all the cruel nature such as the disease which finishes the body and consumes the vital air, enmity, hunger etc; the devotees of such emperumān are singing distinguished songs, dancing joyfully jumping and spreading out all over the world; Oh fickle minded ones! see that you are saved by perfectly placing your heart which is focussed on external matters, approaching such bhāgavatas and engaging in activities which match the quality of servitude.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the sixth pāsuram, āḻvār says “śrīvaiṣṇavas spread everywhere singing and dancing to remove the sorrows of everyone, you also give up any doubts regarding supremacy of other dēvatās and save yourself by surrendering unto emperumān“.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār mercifully says to those who were highlighted in the previous pāsuram “the devotees of sarvēśvaran who has the divine chakra for the protection of his devotees, spread everywhere to remove the worldly sorrows; you surrender unto them to save yourself”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nampiḷḷai‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*Sixth pāsuram. śrīvaiṣṇavas spread everywhere in this world, to remove all the sorrows; you too surrender unto emperumān, along with them and be saved. konṟuyir uṇṇum visādi pagai pasi tīyana ellām ninṟivvulagil kadivān nēmip pirān tamar pōndār nanṟisai pādiyum tuḷḷi ādiyum jñālam parandār senṟu toḻuduymmin toṇḍīr sindaiyaic cenniṟuttiyē*

- *konṟuyir …* – Disease which can shed one’s body and snatch the vital airs. Alternative explanation – disease which can separate the vital airs from the body and finish the body. In this second explanation – *uyir* means body. Enmity and hunger which can also do the same.

When asked “Why is each one of them individually highlighted?”, āḻvār says “to have those lowly aspects”,

- *ninṟu ivvulagil kadivān* – destroyed without leaving behind anything.
- *nēmip pirān tamar pōndār* – Those who were captivated by the beautiful combination of his hand and the chakra, arrived.
- *nanṟu* … – Singing distinguished songs, dancing by jumping up and down, and spreading out everywhere in this manner.
- *senṟu toḻudu uymmin* – You go towards them, worship/serve them and be saved; also explained as – you worship/serve [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) along with them and be saved.
- *toṇḍīr* – You who are serving unsuitable matters. You who are qualified to be reformed.

While doing that,

- *sindaiyaic cenniṟuttiyē* – Worship in such a manner that you don’t say as in “*dēhi mē dadāmi tē*” (I give you something and you give me something back) \[i.e., worship purely, without expecting anything in return\].

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.7. Nirutti num

*niṟutti num uḷḷattuk koḷḷum deyvangaḷ ummai uyyakkōḷ maṟuttum avanōdum kaṇḍīr mārkkaṇḍēyanum kariyē kaṟutta manam onṟum vēṇḍā kaṇṇan allāl deyvam illai iṟuppadellām avan mūrttiyāy avarkkē iṟuminē*

**Пословный перевод:**

num – your; uḷḷattu – in your heart; niṟutti – since they are not subāśrayam (auspicious object of meditation), forcefully holding them \[instead of naturally being present\]; koḷḷum – placing; deyvangaḷ – dēvatās; ummai – you all; uyyak koḷḷum – uplifting; avanōdē – to the one who gave them the ability to bestow benedictions; maṟuttu – by approaching him only; mārkkaṇḍēyanum – mārkaṇḍēya riśi; kari – as witness; kaṇḍīr – see; kaṟutta – contamination (to have faith in other dēvatās); manam – heart; onṟum – in any manner; vēṇḍā – unnecessary; kaṇṇan allāl – except for kriṣṇa (who is the śarīrī (ātmā) of all other dēvatās); deyvam – para dēvatā (supreme dēvatā); illai – not there; iṟuppadu – those nitya and naimittika karmas which are ordained in śāstram; ellām – all of them; avan – for such kriṣṇa; mūrttiyāy avarkkē – pursuing those dēvatās as his body; iṟumin – offer them considering kriṣṇa, who is the enjoyer of all yajñas (sacrifices), as the end goal

**Перевод:**

**Approach only kriṣṇa who gave the dēvatās you all are forcefully holding and placing in your heart since they are not subāśrayam for your upliftment, the ability to bestow benedictions; you have seen that mārkaṇḍēya riśi is a witness for this; it is unnecessary to have any contamination in your heart; except for kriṣṇa, there is no other para dēvatā. Thus, offer all those those nitya and naimittika karmas which are ordained in śāstram, pursuing such dēvatās as body for such kriṣṇa, and offer them considering kriṣṇa, who is the enjoyer of all yajñas (sacrifices), as the end goal.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the seventh pāsuram, āḻvār says “After having established that your dēvatās protect you based on emperumān‘s mercy, you consider them to be “his servitors” and approach them as part of vorśipping him”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says to those servitors of other dēvatās “Without his support, they have no ability to protect; kriṣṇa who is easily approachable in all manners is the supreme lord; this being the case, you see that you meditate them to be his body and engage in those nitya (daily) and naimittika (periodical) karmas (rituals)”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nampiḷḷai‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*Seventh pāsura. Those devotees of other dēvatās tell āḻvār “we have vorśipped our dēvatās for a very long time; we will accept the result for that first and then surrender to bhagavān“; āḻvār replies “I have already shown you that the dēvatās whom you have surrendered to, are protecting you based on his strength; hence, it is best to surrender unto him; but if it is not possible, whenever you offer something to them, think “these dēvatās are dear to bhagavān; we are vorśipping him through them” and offer to them. niṟutti num uḷḷattuk koḷḷum deyvangaḷ ummai uyyakkōḷ maṟuttum avanōdum kaṇḍīr mārkkaṇḍēyanum kariyē kaṟutta manam onṟum vēṇḍā kaṇṇan allāl deyvam illai iṟuppadellām avan mūrttiyāy avarkkē iṟuminē*

- *niṟutti* – It is the responsibility of the meditator to establish the validity of the one who is being meditated upon. They \[other dēvatās\] remain standing only because of these devotees vorśipping them.
- *num uḷḷattuk koḷḷum deyvangaḷ* – dēvatās who are placed in your hearts.
- *uḷḷattuk koḷḷum* – They will meditate upon those dēvatās secretly thinking “if others know that we are vorśipping these personalities, they will mockingly laugh at us”.
- *ummai uyyak koḷ* – The way they became to uplift you all.
- *maṟuttum* … – While you take shelter of them considering “they must be better than he \[[emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)\]”, they in turn approach him and protect you. The ability to protect always rests upon emperumān as said in śrīviṣṇu purāṇam 1.22.21 “*na hi pālana sāmartyamrutē sarvēśvaram harim \| …*” (Oh wise person! Except for hari who is well situated in sustaining others, no one has the ability to give protection).

When asked “While we approach others, how is it that [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) is real benefactor?”, [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) says,

- *mārkkaṇḍēyanum kariyē* – kari means sākśi (proof/witness). mārkaṇḍēya is the proof for this principle. He prayed to a dēvatā (rudra) for a long time. rudra told him “You have prayed to me for a very long time, and this surrender cannot go waste. There is no difference between you and I \[when it comes to having our real goal fulfilled\], and so, I will show you the right path”, led him to sarvēśvaran and fulfilled his desire; thus, he is the proof for this principle.
- *kaṟutta manam onṟum vēṇḍā* – You don’t need the inferior heart of considering lowly dēvatās as supreme lord.
- *kaṇṇan allāl deyvam illai* – As said in mahābhāratam bhīśma parvam “… *sarvē dēvā dēvakī putra Eva*” (vēdams, all fires, all sacrifices, all dēvatās are all kriṣṇa, the son of dēvaki), there is no independent dēvatā who is not body of his; as said in [śrī bhagavat gītā 7.21](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/7-21/) “*yō yō yām yām tanum bhakta:*” (whichever devotee of the dēvatāntarams (other dēvatās) any dēvatā who is \[my\] śarīra (body)), all the dēvatās are his body \[[bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) is the antaryāmi \[in-dwelling super soul\] of all dēvatās\].
- *iṟuppadu* – This being the case, whatever materials you offer to those dēvatās as part of their worship, consider “these dēvatās are his body” and offer those materials to them. iṟuppadellām – all those nitya and naimittika karmas which appear to be for other dēvatās, to those dēvatās who are body for him. Knowing that “sarvēśvaran is the antarātmā” and consider them to be worship for such [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/).

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.8. Irukkum irai

*iṟukkum iṟai iṟuttuṇṇa evvulagukkum tan mūrtti niṟuttinān deyvangaḷāga atteyva nāyagan tānē maṟut tiru mārvan avan tan būdangaḷ gīdangaḷ pādi veṟuppinṟi jñālattu mikkār mēvit toḻuduymminīrē*

**Пословный перевод:**

iṟukkum – to be performed certainly; iṟai – nitya and naimittika karams which are duties \[and thus cannot be given up\]; iṟuttu – offering; uṇṇa – to be uplifted; evvulagukkum – all words which have variegated interests; than – his; mūrtti – different types of forms/bodies; deyvangaḷāga – as the dēvatās who are vorśippable in those karmas; niṟuttinān – established; at teyva nāyagan tānē – kriṣṇa, who is the lord of all lords; maṟu – the śrīvatsa mole which highlights his supremacy; tirumārvan – one who is having on his divine chest; avan than – for him; būdangaḷ – bhāgavatas who are servitors; gīdangaḷ – many songs; pādi – sing; jñālattu – of the worldly defects; veṟuppu inṟi – not having hatred; mikkār – lived as great personalities; nīr – you; mēvi – approaching them; toḻudu – worship; uymmin – be uplifted

**Перевод:**

**kriṣṇa, who is the lord of all lords, established his different types of forms/bodies as the dēvatās who are vorśippable in nitya and naimittika karmas which are duties to be performed certainly by all words which have variegated interests, as an offering to be uplifted. The bhāgavatas, who are servitors of such emperumān who is having the śrīvatsa mole which highlights his supremacy, on his divine chest, singing many songs, without hatred of the worldly defects, lived as great personalities; you be uplifted by approaching and vorśipping them.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the eighth pāsuram, when asked “Has there not been anyone who surrendered to other dēvatās to have their desires fulfilled?”, āḻvār says “It is emperumān who made them fulfil the desires of their devotees; so you surrender unto emperumān himself and be uplifted”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār says “śervitors of such kriṣṇa who is the lord of all dēvatās and the one who has śrīvatsa \[mole on his chest\], have become well established in this world. You surrender unto them and become uplifted”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nampiḷḷai‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*Eighth pāsuram. āḻvār says “emperumān established other dēvatās all over the world to facilitate surrendering of cētanas (sentient beings) who are filled with rajas (passion) and tamas (ignorance) qualities; śrīvaiṣṇavas who are captivated by the distinguished form of such emperumān have spread everywhere. You too, like them, try to surrender unto him”. iṟukkum iṟai iṟuttuṇṇa evvulagukkum than mūrtti niṟuttinān deyvangaḷāga atteyva nāyagan tānē maṟut tiru mārvan avan than būdangaḷ gīdangaḷ pādi veṟuppinṟi jñālattu mikkār mēvit toḻuduymminīrē*

- *iṟukkum* … – As the crop which is sowed, must be dutifully taken care of, to facilitate all of you to provide offerings to the respective dēvatās as per your puṇya/pāpa, he established these dēvatās who are forms/bodies of him, in all the worlds; this is done by [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) himself who is the controller of those dēvatās and others \[who worship them\]. Just as a king would establish administrators in each towns.
- *maṟut tiru mārvan* – One who is having the śrīvatsa mole and śrī mahālakśmi on his chest; also explained as – the one who is having śrīvatsa mole on his divine chest.
- *avan …* – Those śrīvaiṣṇavas who are captivated in his distinguished form, singing songs out of overwhelming love, spread everywhere in the world without the hatred “we have to reside in this \[cruel\] samsāram (material realm)”.
- *mēvit toḻudu uymminīrē* – This being the case, you approach them, surrender unto them and be uplifted; also explained as – being ananyaprayōjanar (exclusive devotees without any ulterior motives) like those satva niśtars (those who are fixed in satva (goodness) guṇam), surrender unto [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) and be uplifted.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.9. Mevit toludu

*mēvit toḻuduymminīrgaḷ vēdap punida irukkai nāviṟkoṇḍaccudan tannai jñāna vidi piḻaiyāmē pūviṟpugaiyum viḷakkum sāndamum nīrum malindu mēvit toḻum adiyārum pagavarum mikkadu ulagē*

**Пословный перевод:**

vēdam – in vēdam; punidam – very purifying, due to revealing bhagavān‘s svarūpa (true nature), guṇa (qualities) etc; irukkai – special hymns such as śrī puruśa sūkta, śrī nārāyaṇa anuvāka; nāvil – in the tongue; koṇḍu – reciting; jñāna vidi – boundaries of the śāstram which reveal jñānam in the form of bhakti; piḻaiyāmē – preserving; pūvil – with flowers; pugaiyum – fragrance/incense smoke; viḷakkum – lamp; sāndamum – sandalwood paste; nīrum – water; malindu – those who are having them completely \[as much as required\]; accudan tannai – sarvēśvaran who never abandons \[his devotees\]; mēvi – being ananyaprayōjana; toḻum – approaching through servitude; adiyārum – servitors; pagavarum – sages who are immersed in meditating upon bhagavān‘s qualities such as jñānam (knowledge), śakti (strength) etc; mikkadu – became filled with; ulagu – this world; mēvi – approaching them; toḻudu – vorśipping them; nīr – you all; uymmingaḷ – be uplifted

**Перевод:**

**This world became filled the devotees of sarvēśvaran who never abandons \[his devotees\], the  servitors and sages of bhagavān, who are ananyaprayōjanas who keep reciting in their tongues the special and very purifying hymns such as śrī puruśa sūkta, śrī nārāyaṇa anuvāka and are preserving the boundaries of the śāstram which reveal jñānam in the form of bhakti, and are approaching him through servitude and are having flowers, fragrance/incense smoke, lamp, sandalwood paste and water completely. This being the case, you all be uplifted by approaching and vorśipping them.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the ninth pāsuram, āḻvār says “This world is filled with those śrīvaiṣṇavas who enjoy serving bhagavān and those śrīvaiṣṇavas who sustain themselves by meditating upon bhagavān’s qualities and cannot do anything beyond that; hence, you too being ananyaprayōjana (exclusively devoted without any ulterior motives) serve bhagavān and be uplifted”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. mēvit toḻuduymminīrgaḷ vēdap punida irukkai nāviṟkoṇḍaccudan tannai jñāna vidi piḻaiyāmē pūviṟpugaiyum viḷakkum sāndamum nīrum malindu mēvit toḻum adiyārum pagavarum mikkadu ulagē*

- *mēvi …* – Become an ananyaprayōjana and be uplifted.
- *vēdap punida irukkai nāvil koṇḍu* – Reciting the sacred hymns of śrī puruśa sūktam etc which reveal more about his true nature, distinguished form and qualities rather than his wealth \[of spiritual and material realm\].
- *accudan tannai* – [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) is of the nature that, even if they recite such hymns in their tongues without their hearts’ intent, still he will consider them to be reciting it heartily and will tell them as in śrī rāmāyaṇam yudda kāṇḍam 8.3 “*na tyajēyam katancana*” (I will never abandon this vibhīśaṇa who approached me with friendship).
- *jñāna vidi piḻaiyāmē* – jñānam indicates bhakti which is a special form of jñānam. Not skipping any of the activities which are forced upon oneself by their own devotion.
- *pūvil* … – The world became filled with śrīVaiṣṇavas who have abundance of flower and incense and other materials which are used in worship and will serve him constantly and who are unable to do anything but \[constantly\] meditating upon [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s qualities. This world became filled with those who are like iḷaiya perumāḷ (lakśmaṇa) (who follows emperumān constantly and serves śrīrāma) and śrī bharatāḻvān (who remained outside ayōdyā constantly meditating upon śrīrāma); you too approach them, serve them and be uplifted.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.10. Mikka ulagugal

*mikka ulagugaḷ tōṟum mēvik kaṇṇan tirumūrtti nakka pirānōdu ayanum indiranum mudalāgat tokka amarar kuḻāngaḷ engum parandana toṇḍīr okkat toḻgiṟṟīr āgil kaliyugam onṟum illaiyē*

**Пословный перевод:**

nakkan pirānōdu – With īśvara (rudra) who is nagna (naked); ayanum – brahmā; indiranum – indra; mudalāga – et al; tokka – together; amarar kuḻāngaḷ – groups of dēvatās; kaṇṇan – kriṣṇa who is the shelter for all, his; tiru – divine; mūrtti – form; mēvi – taking shelter; mikka – having abundance of tools for enjoyment; ulagugaḷ tōṟum – in all worlds; engum – everywhere; parandana – became possessed with great wealth; toṇḍīr – Oh ones who are desirous of worldly goals!; okka – if you too like them; toḻa – worship; kiṟṟirāgil – are able to; kali yugam – the defect of kali yugam (which is the cause for such lowliness of attachment towards other dēvatās); onṟum – anything; illai – not present

**Перевод:**

**Groups of dēvatās together with īśvara (rudra) who is nagna (naked), brahmā, indra et al, having taken shelter of the divine form of kriṣṇa who is the shelter for all, became possessed with great wealth everywhere in all the worlds which are having abundance of tools for enjoyment; oh ones who are desirous of worldly goals! if you too are able to worship \[emperumān\] like them \[those dēvatās\], none of the defects of kali yugam will be present. Implies that, in this kali yugam, the general public will be averse to vorśipping bhagavān and will mostly be following false doctrines.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the tenth pāsuram, āḻvār says “The dēvatās whom you worship, attained their positions by surrendering unto emperumān; so you too surrender unto emperumān and be saved”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, after explaining the greatness of bhāgavatas who are servitors of sarvēśvara, who is greater than all, āḻvār says to those who take shelter of other dēvatās for worldly benefits “if you surrender unto emperumān as done by the dēvatās to fulfil their desires, the defects of this \[kali\] yugam which cause bewilderment of your intelligence will be rid of”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*Tenth pāsuram. āḻvār says “If you do what the dēvatās,you have surrendered to, do, your defects coming from many ages will be rid of”. mikka ulagugaḷ tōṟum mēvik kaṇṇan tirumūrtti nakka pirānōdu ayanum indiranum mudalāgat tokka amarar kuḻāngaḷ engum parandana toṇḍīr okkat toḻgiṟṟīr āgil kaliyugam onṟum illaiyē*

- *mikka* … – Having kriṣṇa’s distinguished form as the auspicious shelter in all the vast worlds.
- *nakkan* … – Having taken shelter of such [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/), all the groups of dēvatās starting with rudra, brahmā, indra et al became located everywhere with great wealth.
- *toṇḍīr* … – Oh you all who are serving unsuitable \[worldly\] aspects! if you too take shelter of [sarvēśvara](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) like them, not only will your defects be gone but also the defects which are induced by the \[kali\] yugam will be gone.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.2.11. Kaliyugam

*kaliyugam onṟum inṟikkē tan adiyārkkaruḷ seyyum maliyum sudar oḷi mūrtti māyap pirān kaṇṇan tannaik kalivayal tennan kurugūrk kārimāṟan satakōpan oli pugaḻ āyirattippatu uḷḷattai māsaṟukkumē*

**Пословный перевод:**

than – his; adiyārkku – for distinguished servitors; kali yugam – the defects of kali yugam; onṟum – anything; inṟikkē – to be affected; aruḷ – out of his grace; seyyum – due to bestowing; maliyum – abundant; sudar – having radiance; oḷi mūrtti – having splendorous form; māyam – having amazing qualities and activities; pirān – one who lets them \[those servitors\] enjoy him; kaṇṇan tannai – on kriṣṇa; kali – abundant; vayal – having fertile farm lands; then – for south direction; nan – worthy; kurugūr – leader of āḻvārtirunagari; kāri – distinguished birth; māṟan – having distinguished family heritage; satakōpan – nammāḻvār‘s; oli – very famous; pugaḻ – speaking about bhagavān’s qualities; āyirattu – among the thousand pāsurams; ippattu – this decad; uḷḷattai – the heart of those who meditate upon; māsu – dirt (considering bhāgavatas to be equal to oneself, doubt in greatness of bhagavān, considering dēvatāntarams to be supreme and attachment towards worldly pleasures); aṟukkum – will eliminate

**Перевод:**

**Due to emperumān‘s bestowing \[of his grace\] for his distinguished servitors, for them to be not affected by the defects of kali yugam, nammāḻvār, the leader of āḻvārtirunagari which is having fertile farm lands and is a worthy town for the south direction, \[such nammāḻvār\] who is having distinguished birth and family heritage, compiled this very famous  decad among the thousand pāsurams which are speaking about bhagavān’s qualities, and are on kriṣṇa, who is having radiant splendorous form, amazing qualities and activities. For those who meditate upon such decad, the dirt in their heart will be eliminated.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the end, āḻvār says “For those who learned this decad, the defect of considering dēvatāntarams to be supreme and the defect in mind of seeking out ulterior motives from emperumān, will be gone”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār explains the result of this decad which is the removal of all impurities in the heart.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kaliyugam onṟum inṟikkē than adiyārkkaruḷ seyyum maliyum sudar oḷi mūrtti māyap pirān kaṇṇan tannaik kalivayal tennan kurugūrk kārimāṟan satakōpan oli pugaḻ āyirattippatu uḷḷattai māsaṟukkumē*

- *kali yugam onṟum inṟikkē* – As said in “*kalau kruta yugam tasya*” (For the one who has gōvinda in his heart, kali yugam feels like kruta yugam), [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) will grace his servitors so that they are not affected by the defects of kali yugam. The wealth allocated for the kingdom will not be the same as what is allocated for the queen’s private quarters \[even if the kingdom is struggling, the king will ensure proper care for his queen; similarly even though worldly people may be suffering in kali yugam, devotees of emperumān will not suffer\].
- *maliyum sudar oḷi mūrtti* – His bodily beauty is such that, even if does not show his mercy, we will not leave him \[just for his beauty\]. Since sudar and oḷi are synonymous, the abundant nature of his radiance is highlighted by those two words. malidal means abundance, indicating, [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s form is filled with great radiance.
- *māyam* … – [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) has sung the glories of kriṣṇa who is having amazing qualities and activities.
- *kali vayal* … – kali means midukku (pride) and āravāram (joyful noise). This implies a) pūcāram (growth); also implies the noise while planting seeds, cutting the crop, ploughing the field etc. This decad, among the thousand pāsurams which have well known fame, which is mercifully compiled by [nammāḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/), who is residing in [āḻvārtirunagari](http://azhwarthirunagari.koyil.org/) which has such fertile fields; such decad will eliminate the defects of heart/mind such as having doubt that dēvatāntarams are supreme; considering other śrīvaiṣṇavas to be equal to oneself, considering “relationship with abhāgavatas” is good and desiring for worldly pleasures.

## 5.3 Masaru sodi

## 5.3.1. Masaru sodi

*māsaṟu sōdi en seyya vāy maṇik kunṟattai āsaṟu seelanai ādi mūrttiyai nādiyē pāsaṟaveydi aṟiviḻandenai nāḷaiyam ēsaṟum ūravar kavvai tōḻi en seyyumē?*

**Пословный перевод:**

māsu – blemish; aṟu – without; sōdi – having tējas (radiance); seyya – reddish; vāy – having mouth; en maṇik kunṟattai – one who is like an emerald mountain, who is enjoyable for me; āsu – defect; aṟu – without; seelanai – One who is having good qualities; ādi – one who first came and bestowed me the enjoyment; mūrttiyai – one who is the lord; nādiyē – seeking out permanently; pāsu – freshness/complexion in my body; aṟaveydi – having lost; aṟivu – wisdom; iḻandu – having lost; enai nāḷaiyam – for how long; tōḻī – Oh friend!; ēsu – in scolding/blaming; aṟum – fixed on; ūravar – the citizens’; kavvai – shouting; en – what; seyyum – will do?

**Перевод:**

**emperumān is having unblemiśed tējas, is having reddish mouth, is like an emerald mountain, and is enjoyable for me; he is having good qualities without any defect and is the one who first came and bestowed me the enjoyment and is my lord. Seeking such emperumān permanently, I have lost the freshness/complexion in my body and have lost my wisdom since long time. What will the shouting that is fixed on scolding/blaming me by the citizens, do \[to me\]?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the first pāsuram, knowing that parānguśa nāyaki is determined to engage in madal, her friend stops her saying “this is forbidden” and parānguśa nāyaki says “I have reached a stage where I don’t fear being blamed, as I have been captivated by his beauty”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*First pāsuram. When the friend says “emperumān is having no shortcoming or blemish in his beauty and qualities. Your act will cause him disrepute” and parānguśa nāyaki says “I am not planning to cause disrepute to him, but am planning to remove the disrespute he already has”. māsaṟu sōdi en seyya vāy maṇik kunṟattai āsaṟu seelanai ādi mūrttiyai nādiyē pāsaṟaveydi aṟiviḻandenai nāḷaiyam ēsaṟum ūravar kavvai tōḻi en seyyumē?*

- *māsaṟu sōdi* – If one \[a woman\] who united and separated with [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/), remains unperturbed and abides by the limits, it is considered as a fault on the other side \[emperumān\]; if the one who became separated does not behave like this, it is a blemish for the beauty. [parānguśa nāyaki](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) is saying, even if I have to cross the limits, I cannot avoid seeing him; while his beauty is such, how can I not engage in madal? Oh stupid \[friend\]! His form is opposite of all blemishes; and if I don’t engage in madal, that will cause a blemish to such form. I am trying to eliminate the blemish of “emperumān will not present his form to those who consider it to be very dear”; the form which is said in jitantē stōtram 5 “*bhaktānām*” (for my devotees), if retained for himself, that is a blemish for such form.
- *māsaṟu sōdi* – [parānguśa nāyaki](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/)‘s friend considers “engaging in madal” is a blemish; \[but\] parānguśa nāyaki considers “not engaging in madal” is a blemish. If she does not go through such agitation in separation, [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s form will also be the same as worldly forms which are seen by us. Since she has embraced emperumān, she first becomes engrossed in his form.
- *māsaṟu sōdi* – She is saying “See, as soon as we announce that we will be engaging in madal, he is arriving without any blemishes”. While his unblemiśed qualities are explained subsequently in “*āsaṟu seelanai*“, she is first speaking about physical beauty, since physical form is more attractive than the qualities.
- *en seyya vāy* – While [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) who is explained in cāndōjña upaniśat 3.14 “*avākyanādara:*” (does not speak, ignores \[in paramapadam\]), after uniting with me, due to the joy acquired in that union, smiled and became totally transformed \[while he is said to be unchanging\], should I remain emotionless while in separation from him? Since there is no one on a par with him to have a conversation, he ignores everyone \[in paramapadam\]. Here, if we say that “there is no transformation due to uniting with his devotees” instead of saying “there is no transformation forced by karma \[worldly action/reaction\]”, then that will imply that there is no mingling with [jīvātmās](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/06/thathva-thrayam-chith-who-am-i/). In fact, it was his pleasant smile which he gave during the union with me, which made me pursue this upāyam (means) of engaging in madal. His joyfully smiling state is similar to the joy acquired by a samsāri \[bound soul\] while becoming mukta (liberated).
- *en seyya vāy* … – It is his distinguished form of smiling face due to uniting with her, which made her engage in madal. She is engaging in madal, facing his \[smiling\] lips; also, she is engaging in madal not whole-heartedly \[she is only doing it due to not having any other means to attain him\].
- *maṇik kunṟattai* – She is saying, “this made me engage in madal truthfully, not just for the sake of it”. He united with me bringing my natural complexion back and cooled me down, and made me not sustain myself even if the talk about separation came about – it is such state of his which made me engage in madal”. Enjoyable like an emerald mountain.
- *āsaṟu seelanai* – She is saying “I did not become captivated just by seeing his beautiful form, but also on seeing his internal qualities”. āsu – blemish/fault. One who is having faultless qualities. Only if he united with me as if it is a benefit for me, I too, while in separation, could do what “I” seek out for; but such a great lord, taking an ordinary position, considered uniting with me as his own benefit; in such case, while in separation, can I think “I won’t leave him if he comes and I won’t search for him if I lost him”? When he maintains the perfection of his qualities, are you asking me to not eliminate the blame?
- *ādi mūrttiyai* – When the friend said to her “As you are born in a high family heritage, instead of waiting for him to come, your becoming agitated is causing disrepute to yourself”, she said “I am not trying to cause disrepute; but I am trying to cause respect”; I am desiring for the entity which is singularly explained in śāstram as in cāndōjña upaniśat “*kāraṇam tu dyēya:*” (meditate upon the origin/cause), and even if one perishes while trying to attain him, it is still respectable. Previously too, \[nampiḷḷai\] mercifully gave an explanation – As said in jitantē stōtram 1 “… *pūrvaja*” (one who puts in the initial effort for the uplifting of [jīvātmās](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/06/thathva-thrayam-chith-who-am-i/)), while he puts in the initial effort to unite with us, should I not manifest suffering in separation before he does?

Still, instead of saying “she got separated from her beloved lord, subsequently (immediately) she engaged in madal”, it looks like we have to say “she remained in grief for some time, and since she could not bear the anguish, she engaged in madal”.

- *nādiyē pāsaṟavu eydi* – Am I suffering just today? I have been suffering for a long time. Whatever efforts he put in to attain me, my suffering in separation was more than that. Forever, I have searched and not seen him and thus ended up only suffering all along; like some will be born in prison and be raised there, my union with him is only a guess based on my separation from him. Only after having searched in all the places where [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) is present, and not having seen him, have I engaged in madal.
- *pāsaṟavu eydi* – Having sorrow. *pāsaṟavu* – sorrow. Also, pāsu means green colour (freshness) and *aṟu* means losing, that is “I have attained different complexion (paleness) \[in separation\]; another explanation – pāsu means pāsam (attachment); i.e., she is saying “I have given up all attachments towards my relatives”.
- *pāsaraveydi* – I have placed all my attachment on [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/).

When said “Whatever may be, this is not done by wise persons”,

- *aṟivu iḻandu enai nāḷaiyam* – It has been a long time since I lost my wisdom. Did I not lose my \[worldly\] wisdom when you bestowed me with “*mayarvaṟa madi nalam*” (unblemiśed knowledge and devotion)? When I sent a tiryak (bird) as messenger, did you think that it was “jñāna kāryam” (an action in knowledge), to come and teach me now? Did I not become bewildered back then as said in [tiruvāimoḻi 1.4.3](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2015/07/thiruvaimozhi-1-4-3-vidhiyinal-pedai/) “*madiyellām uḷ kalangi*” (having the mind totally bewildered)? He is such that, when one comes in contact with them, they will not know anything else, as said in iraṇḍām tiruvandādi 42 “*pērinbam ellām tuṟandār toḻudārattōḷ*” (the shoulder which is well vorśipped by those who gave up all great pleasures). Not only he would make one forget about the material realm while reaching spiritual realm as explained in cāndōjña upaniśat 8.12.3 “*nōpajanam smaran idam śarīram*” ([ātmā](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/06/thathva-thrayam-chith-who-am-i/) will not contemplate about the material body after reaching the spiritual realm), is he not capable of making one forget everything in this world when true knowledge dawns? Is he such that, one can think about him as well as worldly matters?

When said “whatever you may say, you should at least worry for the blaming by people \[around you\]”,

- *ēsaṟum* … – Only if our engaging in madal is a fault, their blaming us will be a fault. The blame which occurs for the wise ones, will not affect us, who have lost our wisdom along with the trace of it; so we need not fear for this. Three explanations are mercifully given for this:
   - The people who are being fearless about blaming her.
   - The people who are anguished thinking “we have ended up blaming the one who is engaged in [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)“.
   - She who is beyond the blaming of worldly people.
- *ūravar kavvai* – Only if those who are engaged in [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) consider this as a fault, it will be a fault; would the accusations presented by worldly people matter to us?
- *tōḻi* – Oh friend who considers my joy and sorrow as yours! only if you consider this as a fault, I will retract \[I don’t care about others’ view\].
- *en seyyumē* – For me who is beyond these worldly accusations, what is the use of the words of such worldly people? We are situated at the stage which is beyond the praising/blaming of worldly people; are these accusations insulting to us? Don’t we sustain ourselves by these worldly accusations? It is said in kuṟaḷ 1141 “*alar eḻil \[eḻa\] āruyir niṟkum…*” (Our love gets sustained by the people’s accusations). As said in tiruvāimoḻi 7.3.8 “*alar tūṟṟiṟṟadu mudalāk koṇḍa en kādal*” (my love which is sustained by the accusations of the people).

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.
