## 5.5.11. Arivariya piranai

*aṟivariya pirānai āḻiyangaiyanaiyē alaṟṟi naṟiya nanmalar nādi nankurugūrc catakōpan sonna kuṟi koḷ āyirattuḷ ivai pattum tirukkuṟungudi adan mēl aṟiyak kaṟṟu vallār vaittaṇavar āḻ kadal jñālattuḷḷē*

**Пословный перевод:**

aṟivu – to know; ariya – impossible; pirānai – being lord; āḻi – the divine chakra (which reveals that lordship); am – beautiful; kaiyanai – having in his divine hand; alaṟṟi – talk unceasingly (highlighting his love); naṟiya – having ultimate fragrance; nal – best; malar – like flowers; nādi – seeking out; nan – having distinguished jñānam etc which gives qualification to enjoy \[bhagavān\]; kurugūr – the leader of āḻvārtirunuagari; satakōpan – nammāḻvār; sonna – blessed; āyirattuḷ – among the thousand pāsurams; kuṟi – the symbols in the form, weapons and ornaments; koḷ – having; tirukkuṟungudi adan mēl ivai pattum – this decad about tirukkuṟungudi; aṟiya – to have their knowledge shining; kaṟṟu – learn; vallār – those who can meditate upon the meanings; āḻ – deep; kadal – surrounded by ocean; jñālattu uḷḷē – in the earth; vaittaṇavar – will live, having distinguished relationship with bhagavān and experience of him

**Перевод:**

**tirukkuṟungudi nambi is the supreme lord, who is impossible to be known and is having divine chakra in his beautiful divine hand; nammāḻvār who is the leader of āḻvārtirunagari and is having distinguished jñānam etc which gives qualification to enjoy \[bhagavān\], talking unceasingly, seeks out such emperumān like seeking out for the best flowers having ultimate fragrance, blessed this decad among the thousand pāsurams; those who can learn and meditate upon the meanings of this decad to have their knowledge shining, will live, having distinguished relationship with bhagavān and experience of him on this earth which is surrounded by deep ocean.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the end, āḻvār says “Those who practice this decad are vaiṣṇavas in this samsāram (material realm) itself”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār explains the realisation of true nature, i.e. having servitude towards bhagavān, as the result of practicing this decad.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. aṟivariya pirānai āḻiyangaiyanaiyē alaṟṟi naṟiya nanmalar nādi nankurugūrc catakōpan sonna kuṟi koḷ āyirattuḷ ivai pattum tirukkuṟungudi adan mēl aṟiyak kaṟṟu vallār vaittaṇavar āḻ kadal jñālattuḷḷē*

- *aṟivariya pirānai* – Whether we attain him or not, at least we did not engage in self effort to attain him. \[Even without the self-effort\] as [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) is already existing, one can easily attain him and enjoy him whenever desired. Are they \[mothers\] engaged in self-effort to know about him? They must be; if they think that they can withdraw parānguśa nāyaki on their own effort, they also think that “we can know about him on our own effort”.
- *āḻi am kaiyanaiyē alaṟṟi* – As he began saying “*sanginōdum nēmiyōdum*” (with the conch and disc) in the first pāsuram, he completes too \[saying “*āḻi am kaiyan*“\]. No one can enjoy him like [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) without giving up \[alternative explanation – without leaving aside his hand\]. Previously āḻvār enjoyed the divine beautiful combination of his hand and chakra along with other beautiful aspects; but here \[in this pāsuram\], he is fully focussed on the divine hand and chakra combination and is talking about that only unceasingly.
- *naṟiya nan malar nādi* – Seeking out for the most fragrant  and best flowers. It is said in [tiruvāimoḻi 2.4.11](https://divyaprabandham.koyil.org/index.php/2016/03/thiruvaimozhi-2-4-11-vattamil-pugazh/) “*adi sūttalāgum andāmamē*” (his divine feet should be decorated with beautiful garlands).
- *nan kurugūrc catakōpan* – It is the birth in that town which caused this overwhelming love in [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/).
- *kuṟi koḷ* … – Among the thousand pāsurams, this decad which fully reveals nambi’s beauty is focussed on [tirukkuṟungudi](http://thirukkurungudi.koyil.org/). This decad which collectively/expansively explained the divine beauty of nambi due to his being decorated with the divine weapons and divine ornaments.
- *aṟiyak kaṟṟu vallār* – Those can learn \[this decad\] and know well. Knowing and learning means – knowing and meditating upon the fact “nambi’s presence in [tirukkuṟungudi](http://thirukkurungudi.koyil.org/) is greater than [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s presence amidst the nityasūris in śrīvaikuṇṭam, with respect to the revelation of his qualities \[such as saulabhyam (simplicity) etc\]”. An entity is glorified due to its qualities only; wherever such qualities are revealed, that is where greatness lies.
- *āḻ kadal jñālattu uḷḷē vaittaṇavar –* Those who know the distinguished nature of *ugandaruḷina nilangaḷ* (divya dēśams – the divine abodes where [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) himself is happily residing), will live like nityasūris while being in this samsāram (material realm) which is like a desert.

## 5.6 Kadal jnalam

## 5.6.1. Kadal jnalam

*kadal jñālam seydēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam āvēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam koṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam kīṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam uṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālattīsan vandēṟakkolō? kadal jñālattīrkkivai en sollugēn kadal jñālatten magaḷ kaṟkinṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kadal – surrounded by ocean; jñālam – earth; seydēnum – one who created; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kadal jñālam āvēnum – (after creating, entering into, and as said in taittirīya upaniśat “saccatyaccā bhavat“) being the antaryāmi of every entity which is named; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kadal jñālam – this earth; koṇḍēnum – (when mahābali considers it to be his own, went and begged, ) measured and accepted; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kadal jñālam – this earth; kīṇḍēnum – dug it out; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kadal jñālam – this earth; uṇḍēnum – annihilated \[and consumed\]; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kadal jñālattu īsan – sarvēśvaran, the controller of all worlds; vandu – came; ēṟa – entered her; kolō – is it possible?; kadal jñālattīrkku – you all who are ignorant and engaged in worldly pursuits; kadal jñālattu – being present in this world itself; en magaḷ – my daughter (who has a divine nature); kaṟkinṟa – practicing; ivai – these amazing aspects; en – how; solluvēn – can explain?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “I am the one who created this earth which is surrounded by ocean”; she said “I am the one who measured the earth”; she said “I dug the earth out”; she said “I annihilated this earth”; is it possible that sarvēśvaran, the controller of all worlds, has come and entered in to her? Oh you all who are ignorant and engaged in worldly pursuits! How can I explain these amazing aspects which are practiced by my daughter? uṇḍēn can also imply the bālakriṣṇa (child kriṣṇa) form on banyan leaf during deluge.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the first pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is saying that she is engaged in activities such as creation etc of earth; it appears that she has been possessed by emperumān and speaking due to that”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kadal jñālam seydēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam āvēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam koṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam kīṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālam uṇḍēnum yānē ennum kadal jñālattīsan vandēṟakkolō? kadal jñālattīrkkivai en sollugēn kadal jñālatten magaḷ kaṟkinṟavē*

- *kadal jñālam seydēnum* … – She said as in [śrī bhagavat gītā 7.6](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/7-6/) “*aham krutsnasya jagata: prabhava:*” (I am the origin for all these worlds). She said “I created this world, when all the objects of world were annihilated and had no name/form as said in cāndōjña upaniśat ‘*sadēva’* (sat (brahmam, the supreme lord) alone existed)”. brahmam which is together with sūkśma cit acit (sentient beings and insentient entities in subtle form) is the kāraṇam (cause); when the subtle form transforms into gross form, it becomes the effect. Since [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) alone is the cause along with his own subtle cit and acit, and since there is no other cause, he himself is all three types of causes which are explained viz upādāna kāraṇam (raw material cause), nimitta kāraṇam (efficient cause) and sahākāri kāraṇam (instrumental/ancillary cause). My daughter said she herself remained all the three causes and created this world. By the usage of avadāraṇam (certainty, “E” in *yānē*), the existence of other causes is nullified.
- *kadal jñālam āvēnum* … – As said in taittirīya upaniśat “*tatsruśtvā tadēvānuprāviśat tadanupraviśya saccatyaccābhavat*” (He created everything and entered in them; by pervading them, he became the sentient and insentient entities), she said “I created them, I entered them to have them recognised by a name and form, and I became them so that every time they are named, it points to me who is the in-dwelling super soul”. Whether it is vācakam \[collective indication of all three entities namely body, soul and super-soul, as per our own philosophy\] or bōdakam \[first explaining the body, then extending up to the soul and further extending up to the super-soul, as per prābhākara philosophy\], \[all words\] will point to him only; first the word will indicate the object that is visible and subsequently it will go up to the invisible [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) \[who is inside the insentient body and further, the sentient soul\]; alternatively – the word will also indicate the togetherness of insentient body, sentient soul and the lord \[For example, if we say “goat”, it identifies the body of the goat, the soul which is inside the body and the antaryāmi which is inside the soul\]. In “*saccatyaccā bhavat*” (He became cit and acit), by saying “*tat anupraviśya*” (he entered), it is established that – this is not svarūpa aikyam (that, brahmam has literally become something else), but its merely talking about the effect of anu pravēśam \[the presence of [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) as antaryāmi\].
- *kadal jñālam koṇḍēnum* … – After creating the worlds, instead of leaving them on their own, he carefully follows them and protects them. She said “when persons like mahābali claim ownership of them as an eagle would grab a helpless animal, I will do whatever it takes to reclaim them”.
- *yānē* – indra only requested [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) “please reclaim my kingdom” knowing well that the demoniac persons cannot win over him; but it was only emperumān who knew the tactics to make himself a seeker to satisfy mahābali’s generosity and reclaimed the world.
- *kadal jñālam kīṇḍēnum* … – She said “Instead of the demoniac persons destroying this world, when the ocean which was placed as a protective layer for the earth, itself consumed the world, I was the one who immersed into the water, reached up to the world which was stuck in the wall of the ocean and brought it out”. The earth which drowned in the ocean did not request him to be protected, but he rescued it on his own desire.
- *uṇḍēnum* … – She said “Instead of leaving some but consuming others, irrespective of creators, annihilators or common objects, everything was under threat of extinction during total deluge; at that time, I placed them all in my stomach and protected”. At that time, no one else existed to even claim that they protected these entities.
- *īsan* – I am not sure “if [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who is the creator of all, the omnipresent, the protector of all, has entered her and she has become possessed of him”.

While we have come to enquire you about her, you are asking us this question? How can we determine her situation now?

- *kadal jñālattīrkku …* – Like it is said in “*vaikuntattamarar*” (nityasūris of paramapadam) \[here they (enquirers) are addressed as *kadal jñālattīr*“\], how can I explain it to you who are nitya samsāris (eternally bound in this material world) who have no idea about bhagavat viśayam? kolō should not be considered as a doubt \[that [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) may or may not have entered her\], but it is certainty \[surely, emperumān has entered her\].
- *kadal* … – These words \[which are spoken by parānuśa nāyaki\] are spoken by nityasūris; when my daughter who is in this material world recites the words of nityasūris, what can I do!

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.2. Karkum kalvikku

*kaṟkum kalvikkellai ilanē ennum kaṟkum kalvi āvēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi seyvēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi tīrppēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvic cāramum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi nātan vandēṟakkolō kaṟkum kalviyīrkkivai en sollugēn? kaṟkum kalvi en magaḷ kāṇginṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kaṟkum – learnt (not through books or observation, but through an ācārya); kalvikku – knowledge in the form of vēdam \[sacred text\]; ellai – boundary; ilan – not having; ennum – she said; kaṟkum kalvi āvēnum – Being the soul of śabda (vēdam), to have that knowledge as my prakāra (attributes); yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kaṟkum kalvi – this knowledge; seyvēnum – creator (During sruśti (creation), I create them as they existed before according to suptaprabudda nyāyam (the logic of recollecting everything after waking up)); yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kaṟkum kalvi tīrppēnum – during deluge, finishing it and preserving it in my heart; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kaṟkum kalvic cāramum – mūla mantram etc which are the essence of that knowledge; yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; kaṟkum kalvi – the propounder of all of vēdam; nātan – sarvēśvaran; vandēṟa – entered her; kolō – is it possible?; kaṟkum kalviyīrkku – you who are ready to learn these from me; kaṟkum kalvi – now in learning age; en magaḷ – my daughter; kāṇginṟa – the vision she had and speaking; ivai – these; en – what; sollugēn – shall I say?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said there is no boundary for knowledge that is learnt in the form of vēdam; she said I am the soul of śabda (vēdam), to have that knowledge as my prakāra (attributes); she said I am the creator of this knowledge; she said I am finishing it and preserving it in my heart during deluge; she said mūla mantram etc which are the essence of that knowledge are at my disposal; is it possible that sarvēśvaran, the propounder of all of vēdam, has entered her? What shall I say to you who are ready to learn these from me on what my daughter, who is now in learning stage, speaks based on the vision she had?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the second pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is saying that all the knowledge revealing vēdams and the propagation of such knowledge are fully at my disposal”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kaṟkum kalvikkellai ilanē ennum kaṟkum kalvi āvēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi seyvēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi tīrppēnum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvic cāramum yānē ennum kaṟkum kalvi nātan vandēṟakkolō kaṟkum kalviyīrkkivai en sollugēn? kaṟkum kalvi en magaḷ kāṇginṟavē*

- *kaṟkum* … – She said “There is no boundary to what I learn from sāndīpani within a short span of time”. Alternatively – she is saying “I am not properly situated to learn śruti (vēdam) which is stated in taittirīya upaniśat “*yatō vācō nivartantē*” (the speech returned unable to comprehend [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s qualities). I am not inside the boundary to learn. Another explanation – I am the knover of vēdāntam as said in “*vēdānta viḻup poruḷin mēl irunda viḷakkai*” (the light atop the vēdāntam).
- *āvēnum* – Did I just not remain incomprehensible by vēdāntam? Are they not at my complete disposal? This is explained in “*tvamēva vidyā”* (you are the knowledge).
- *seyvēnum* – She said “I will create that knowledge at the appropriate times”.
- *kaṟkum kalvi tīrppēnum* – She said “I will eliminate any doubts in them and establish the essence in them”. There are those who are greatly learned yet say “*sūnyamē tatvam*” (voidness is truth). Also explained as, [parānguśa nāyaki](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) saying “those students and teachers are at my disposal”. Would *tīrppēn* (finish) mean teaching/learning? Yes. tīrkkai means seeking the ultimate aspect of it.
- *sāramum* – She is saying that “I am the result of those essential aspects of that knowledge”.
- *nātan vandēṟak kolō* – Did the all knowing lord enter into my daughter?
- *kaṟkum* … – What shall I say to you who don’t even know the very basics of bhagavat viśayam, to learn and know now?
- *kaṟkum* … – What shall I say about the engagement of my daughter in this manner? She is of very tender nature  and is not speaking at all while earlier she would repeat every word and not say a word of her own.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.3. Kanginra nilam

*kāṇginṟa nilam ellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa visumbellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa ventīyellām  yānē ennum kāṇginṟa ik kāṟṟellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa kadal ellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa kadal vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? kāṇginṟa ulagattīrkken sollugēn kāṇginṟa en kārigai seyginṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kāṇginṟa – seen (through pramāṇam); nilam ellām – all the prutvi (land/earth, which is the last of the five elements); yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kāṇginṟa – seen, in the same manner; visumbu – ākāśam (Ether, which is the first of the five elements); ellām – all; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kāṇginṟa – main among the luminous objects; vem – hot; tī – agni (fire); ellām – all; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kāṇginṟa – the previous element \[to fire, in sequence of creation\]; i – these – being in close proximity, due to sustaining; kāṟṟu ellām – vāyus (airs); yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kāṇginṟa – the next element \[to air, in sequence of creation\]; kadal – water; ellām – all; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kāṇginṟa – attractive; kadal – (infinite) ocean like; vaṇṇan – sarvēśvaran who is having such form; ēṟak kolō – has entered?; kāṇginṟa – seeing; ulagattīrkku – you who don’t know anything beyond this world; kāṇginṟa – my very beautiful daughter who can see what is not seen by any one; kārigai – daughter; seyginṟa – actions; en – in what way; sollugēn – I can explain

**Перевод:**

**My daughter, parānguśa nāyaki said “I am all the land which is seen”; she said “I am the ether which is seen”; she said “I am the hot fire, which is main among the luminous objects”; she said “I am all these vāyus, which arrive previous \[to fire, in creation sequence\], which are in close proximity, due to sustaining us”; she said “I am all the water, which is the next element \[to air in creation sequence\]”; Has sarvēśvaran who is having an ocean like attractive form, entered into her? Oh you who don’t know anything beyond this world which you are seeing! In what way can I explain the actions of my very beautiful daughter who can see what is not seen by any one?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the th pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is saying that the unlimited panca bhūtams (five elements) starting with earth are all at her disposal”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is saying that the panca bhūtams (five elements) which are the main cause for the universe which is known through pramāṇams (authentic scriptures), are all at her disposal”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kāṇginṟa nilam ellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa visumbellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa ventīyellām  yānē ennum kāṇginṟa ik kāṟṟellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa kadal ellām yānē ennum kāṇginṟa kadal vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? kāṇginṟa ulagattīrkken sollugēn kāṇginṟa en kārigai seyginṟavē*

- *kāṇginṟa* *nilam* … – She is saying that the whole land mass which cannot be seen if one sets out to see them, is at my disposal. This is the prutvi (earth) which is in the form of effect and can be seen by our eyes. If this itself is so vast, the nature of the prutvi which is in the causal form can only be known by śāstram and is much greater than the visible earth.
- *kāṇginṟa visumbu* … –  She said that the ākāśam (ether/space) which provides space for this vast earth, which cannot be fully seen, is also at her disposal.
- *kāṇginṟa* *ikkāṟṟu* … – In the same manner, she said that the fire and the air which can be felt, are at her disposal.
- *kāṇginṟa kadal vaṇṇan …* – She said that the ocean which cannot be fully seen by those who desire to see it, is also at her disposal. Did the [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who is having invigorating ocean like form, where the onlookers cannot take their eyes off, come and enter her?
- *kāṇginṟa ulagattīrkku …* – As you too are watching her like me, what can I tell you now; is there any difference between you and me, in being unable to explain her state?
- *kāṇginṟa* *en kārigai* … – What can I explain about my daughter who is immersed in the infinite [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) as said in taittirīya upaniśat “*yatō vācō nivartantē*” (the speech returned unable to measure [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s qualities) and is speaking about him?

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.4. Seyginra kidi

*seyginṟa kidi ellām yānē ennum seyvāninṟanagaḷum yānē ennum seydu mun iṟandavum yānē ennum seygaip payan uṇbēnum yānē ennum seyvārgaḷaic ceyvēnum yānē ennum seyya kamalak kaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? seyya ulagattīrkkivai en sollugēn? seyya kani vāy iḷamān tiṟattē*

**Пословный перевод:**

seyginṟa – being performed; kidi – (present) karma/kriyā (actions); ellām – all; yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; seyvān – to be performed; ninṟanagaḷum – actions that are waiting (in future); yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; mun – previously; seydu – performed; iṟandavum – actions that were completed (in the past); yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; seygai – for these actions; payan – results; uṇbēnum – enjoyer; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; seyvārgaḷai – for the performers of these actions; seyvēnum – creator; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; seyya – reddish; kamalam – lotus like; kaṇṇan – sarvēśvaran having eyes; ēṟak kolō – is it due to his entering her?; seyya – you who are honest/straightforward; ulagattīrkku – for the worldly people; seyya – reddish; kani – fruit like; vāy – having lips; iḷam – young; mān – doe; tiṟattu – in her matter; ivai – these; en – what; sollugēn – shall I say?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “all karma/kriyā (actions) which are being performed are at my disposal”; she said “all actions which are waiting to be performed are at my disposal”; she said “all actions which  were previously performed and completed are at my disposal”; she said “I am the enjoyer of the results of these actions”; she said “I am the creator of the performers of these actions”; is this due to sarvēśvaran who is having reddish lotus like eyes entering her? What shall I say to you who are honest/straightforward worldly people in the matter of my young doe like daughter who is having reddish fruit like lips?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the fourth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is saying that all actions/rituals etc are at her disposal”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. seyginṟa kidi ellām yānē ennum seyvāninṟanagaḷum yānē ennum seydu mun iṟandavum yānē ennum seygaip payan uṇbēnum yānē ennum seyvārgaḷaic ceyvēnum yānē ennum seyya kamalak kaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? seyya ulagattīrkkivai en sollugēn? seyya kani vāy iḷamān tiṟattē*

- *seyginṟa kidi* … – She is saying that all actions which are being performed in the present, waiting to be performed in future and completed in the past, are all at my disposal.
- *seygaip payan uṇbēnum* … – She said as in śrī bhagavat gītā 10.25 “*aham hi sarva yajñānām bhōktā ca*” (I am the enjoyer of all sacrifices). She said that the enjoyers of the results of actions are at my disposal. Alternatively she is saying that both the actions and the enjoyer of the results of such actions are at my disposal.
- *seyvārgaḷai* … – She said that I am the one who facilitates the performers of actions and will make them perform those actions. Alternative explanation – she said that I am the one who makes them perform these actions and surrender unto me.
- *seyya kamalak kaṇṇan* … – She transformed from being “*asitēkśaṇā*” (one with black eyes) to be “*puṇḍarikākśa*” (lotus like red eyes). She transformed from being “*maiya kaṇṇāḷ*” (black eyed) to be “*seyya kōlat tadam kaṇṇan*” (one with beautiful big reddish eyes).
- *seyya ulagattīrkku* – Instead of knowing whether it can be explained or not, you keep requesting me to tell about her – what shall I say to you?
- *seyya kani vāy …* – Due to her enactment of [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/), as during the time of samślēśam (union), her lips are red; what shall I say about my daughter who is emotionally charged and very young? While the lips become pale during separation, they are red due to her sustenance by enactment. \[What shall I say about \] the matters relating to my daughter who is having reddish lips and is resembling a very young deer.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.5. Tirambamal

*tiṟambāmal maṇ kākkinṟēn yānē ennum tiṟambāmal malai eduttēnē ennum tiṟambāmal asuraraik konṟēnē ennum tiṟam kātti anṟu aivaraik kāttēnē ennum tiṟambāmal kadal kadaindēnē ennum tiṟambāda kadal vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? tiṟambāda ulagattīrkken sollugēn? tiṟambāden tirumagaḷ eydinavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

tiṟambāmal – not violating the norms; maṇ – universe; kākkinṟēn – protecting; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; tiṟambāmal – to hold it still \[ \[to avoid any disturbance to those who have taken shelter underneath\]; malai – \[gōvardana\] hill; eduttēnē – I lifted; ennum – she said; tiṟambāmal – without letting anyone escape; asurarai – demons (such ariśta, dēnu et al); konēnē – I killed; ennum – she said; tiṟam – strengths (which highlight his ability to be victorious); kātti – manifested; anṟu – long ago (when duryōdana et al were fighting them); aivarai – the five pāṇḍavas; kāttēnē – I protected; ennum – she said; tiṟambāmal – without forgetting \[the purpose\]; kadal – ocean; kadaindēnē – churned; ennum – she said; tiṟambāda – one who does not falter (in protecting his devotees); kadal vaṇṇan – one who has ocean like form/colour; ēṟak kolō – is this how emperumān entered her?; tiṟambāda – fixated on knowing \[about parānguśa nāyaki\]; ulagattīrkku – for the worldly people; en – my; tiru – comparable to lakśmī; magaḷ – daughter; tirambādu – without missing; eydina – the qualities that are attained; en – in what way; sollogēn – shall I explain?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “I am the one who is protecting the world, by not violating the norms; she said “I lifted the gōvardan hill and held it still”; she said “I killed all the demons without letting anyone escape”; she said “Long ago, I protected the five pāṇḍavas by manifesting my strengths”; she said “I churned the ocean without forgetting the purpose”; is this how emperumān who does not falter and who has ocean like form/colour, entered her? In what way shall I explain to the worldly people who are fixated on knowing about the qualities attained by my daughter who is comparable to lakśmī?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the fifth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter said that she is the one who performs activities such as protecting the universe etc”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. tiṟambāmal maṇ kākkinṟēn yānē ennum tiṟambāmal malai eduttēnē ennum tiṟambāmal asuraraik konṟēnē ennum tiṟam kātti anṟu aivaraik kāttēnē ennum tiṟambāmal kadal kadaindēnē ennum tiṟambāda kadal vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? tiṟambāda ulagattīrkken sollugēn? tiṟambāden tirumagaḷ eydinavē*

- *tiṟambāmal* … – To ensure that one person’s clothes are not worn by seven persons \[to maintain some order\], and as said in taittirīya upaniśat “*bhīśāsmāt vāta*:*pavatē*” (fearing [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s orders, wind is blowing), I am protecting the earth. She said “I lifted the gōvardana hill and ensured that not even a single drop of rain touched a cow or a covherd boy”. She also said “I completely destroyed the groups of asuras without leaving anyone behind”.
- *tiṟam kātti* … – Manifesting my qualities in this world; she said “I protected pāṇḍavas back then by showing partiality towards pāṇḍavas by changing day to night, taking up arms after vowing not to do so and showing the life spot of the enemies”. He made arjuna who said in [śrī bhagavat gītā 1.32](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/1-32/) “*na kānkśē vijayam kriṣṇa”* (Oh kriṣṇa! I don’t have any desire for victory) to say as in śrī bhagavat gītā 18.73 “*kariśyē vacanam tava*” (I will execute your words immediately).
- *tiṟambāmal kadal …* – She said “I was the one who churned the great ocean using the mantar mountain as the hand-mortar, without having it overflow in any direction, similar to curd being churned inside a pot without spilling anywhere”.
- *tiṟambāda kadal vaṇṇan …* – Did [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who has unlimited capabilities to have no one violate his rules, come and enter her?
- *tiṟambāda ulagattīrkku* … – What shall I say to you who are determined not to leave this place without hearing the explanation from me? What shall I say about my daughter who is equivalent to lakśmī, who attained that which cannot be withdrawn by any of our advice? How can some one in the shore explain about a person who is deep in the ocean?

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.6. Inavey malai

*inavēy malai ēndinēn yānē ennum ina ēṟugaḷ seṟṟēnum yānē ennum ina ān kanṟu mēyttēnum  yānē ennum ina ānirai kāttēnum yānē ennum ina āyar talaivanum yānē ennum inat tēvar talaivan vandēṟak kolō? inavēṟkaṇṇalleerkkivai en sollugēn? inavēṟkaṇṇi en magaḷ uṟṟanavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

inam – abundant; vēy – having bamboos; malai – gōvardana hill; ēndinēn – lifted; yānē – I; ennum – she said; inam – surrounded; ēṟugaḷ – seven bulls; seṟṟēnum – killed; yānē – I; ennum – she said; inam – as a single herd; An kanṟu – calves; mēyttunum – shepherded; yānē – I; ennum – she said; inam – groups of; ānirai – cows; kāttēnum – protected; yānē – I; ennum – she said; inam – having similar qualities; āyar – for the covherd boys; talaivanum – leader; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; inam – assembled; dēvar – nityasūris; talaivan – sarvēśvaran, who is the controller; vandēṟak kolō – did he enter?; inam – enriched; vēl – like a spear; kaṇ – having beautiful eyes; nalleerkku – for you all; vēl – spear; inam – matching; kaṇṇi – having eye; en – my; magaḷ – daughter; uṟṟana – acquired; ivai – these aspects; en – how; sollugēn – shall I explain?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “I lifted the gōvardana hill which is having abundance of bamboos”; she said “I killed the seven bulls which surrounded me”; she said “I shepherded the calves as a single herd”; she said “I am the leader among the covherd boys who have similar qualities like me”;did sarvēśvaran, who is the controller of the assembled nityasūris enter her? How shall I explain these aspects acquired by my daughter who is having a matching spear like eye to you all who are having enriched spear like beautiful eyes?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the sixth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “She said that she is the one who performed kriṣṇa leelās such as lifting up the gōvardana hill”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. inavēy malai ēndinēn yānē ennum ina ēṟugaḷ seṟṟēnum yānē ennum ina An kanṟu mēyttēnum  yānē ennum ina ānirai kāttēnum yānē ennum ina āyar talaivanum yānē ennum inat tēvar talaivan vandēṟak kolō? inavēṟkaṇṇalleerkkivai en sollugēn? inavēṟkaṇṇi en magaḷ uṟṟanavē*

- *ina vēy malai* … – She said “I effortlessly held the gōvardana hill which has abundance of bamboos, like an umbrella was held upside down”.
- *inam* *ēṟugaḷ* … – She said “Not just one or two, but seven deadly bulls were killed at once by me by strangling their necks”.
- *ina An kanṟu* … – She said “I shepherded the calves which were of the same age as me as said in śrīviṣṇu purāṇam 5.17.19  ‘*vatsa madyagatam bālam’ (*child amidst calves)”.
- *ina ānirai* … – She said “as those who practice brahmacaryam (bacelorhood) followed by gārhastya darmam (householder life), I first tended the calves in my childhood and later tended cows”.
- *ina āyar …* – She said “While I engage in mischievous activities along with the covherd boys of my age as said in periyāḻvār tirumoḻi 3.1.1 “*tannērāyira piḷḷaigaḷōdu*” (kriṣṇa along with boys who match his age, qualities etc), there is none who can match my misciefs”.
- *inat tēvar* … – Did the leader of nityasūris who are comparable to [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) in not having any expectations from anyone, enter my daughter? \[Here, *inam* is explained as “same species”\]
- *inat tēvar* … -Alternate explanation – Since the nityasūris do not enjoy [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) individually and enjoy as a group only, inam indicates many groups of nityasūris. It is already said in tiruvāimoḻi 2.3.10 “*adiyārgaḷ kuḻāngaḷ*” (groups of nityasūris).
- *ina vēl …* – What shall I say to you all who are sharply observing her thinking “what will she end up with?”.

When asked “What is the difficulty in explaining?”, she says

- *ina vēl kaṇṇi* … – Shall I explain the torment she is going through which would normally be experienced by those who are caught in her eyes? Those who are caught in her eyes go through what is explained in tiruviruttam 6 “*uyir kāmingaḷ jñālattuḷḷē”* (Oh those who are in this world! Save yourself).

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.7. Urrargal enakku

*uṟṟārgaḷ enakkillai yārum ennum uṟṟārgaḷ ennakkingellārum ennum uṟṟārgaḷaic ceyvēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārgaḷai aḻippēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārgaḷukkuṟṟēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārili māyan vandēṟak kolō? uṟṟīrgatken sollic collugēn yān? uṟṟennudaip pēdai uraikkinṟavē*

**Пословный перевод:**

uṟṟārgaḷ – relatives (who approach me due to a particular reason \[seeking something\] or who approach me knowing me truly well); enakku – for me; yārum – any one; illai – not present; ennum – she said; ingu – in this world; ellārum – everyone; enakku – for me; uṟṟārgaḷ – relatives; ennum – she said; uṟṟārgaḷai – to be my relative; seyvēnum – will make; yānē – I; ennum – she said; uṟṟārgaḷai – those who approached me with ulterior motives; aḻippēnum – cut off my relationship (by bestowing what they ask for \[and pushing them away\]); yānē – I; ennum – she said; uṟṟārgaḷukku – those who approached me without any ulterior motives; uṟṟēnum – all types of relationships; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; uṟṟār – no matter how intelligent one is, one who saw him \[by his own effort\]; ili – not present; māyan – amazing lord; vandēṟak kolō – is this how he entered her?; uṟṟirgatku – for you all who are my relatives; ennudaip pēdai – very young daughter of mine; uṟṟu – seen through her inner vision; uraikkinṟa – the words which are spoken; en – how; solli – tell; soluugēn – will explain?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “there are no relatives present  for me”; she said “in this world, everyone is my relative”; she said “I will make them to be my relatives”; she said “I will cut off my relationship with those who approached me with ulterior motives”; she said “I will be all types of relationships for those approach me without any ulterior motives”; is this how the amazing lord who is not seen by anyone no matter how intelligent one is, entered her? How will I tell and explain to you all who are my relatives about my very young daughter’s inner vision and the words spoken by her?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the seventh pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter is speaking about emperrumān’s relationship with his devotees as her own”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. uṟṟārgaḷ enakkillai yārum ennum uṟṟārgaḷ ennakkingellārum ennum uṟṟārgaḷaic ceyvēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārgaḷai aḻippēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārgaḷukkuṟṟēnum yānē ennum uṟṟārili māyan vandēṟak kolō? uṟṟīrgatken sollic collugēn yān? uṟṟennudaip pēdai uraikkinṟavē*

- *uṟṟārgaḷ enakku illai yārum ennum* – She said “there is no relative for me due to a particular reason \[based on one’s karma\]”. Alternative explanation – there is no one who knows his/ her true relationship with me and be friendly/devoted towards me. Even after reciting as said in nārāyaṇa sūktam “*patim viśvasya*” (he is the lord of the entire universe), they will go and worship other dēvatās \[Just reciting verses mechanically and not putting the principle into practice\].
- *uṟṟārgaḷ enakku ingu ellārum ennum* – She said “there is no one who is not a natural relative to me”. That is, though they themselves would not show natural attachment towards me , I would manifest natural relationship and care towards them.
- *uṟṟārgaḷaic ceyvēnum yānē ennum* – She said “I will select some of them and make them approach me”.
- *uṟṟārgaḷai aḻippēnum yānē ennum* – She said “if they become attached to worldly pleasures, I will bestow those pleasures to them and push them away from me”. Alternative explanation – iḷaiyaperumāḷ a disciple of [mudaliyāṇḍān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/mudhaliyANdAn/) mercifully explained as heard from āṇḍān – she said “I will destroy them \[their worldly pleasures\] by manifesting my beauty etc”.
- *uṟṟārgaḷukku uṟṟēnum yānē ennum* – She said “for those who are exclusively devoted to me, I too will be exclusively committed to them”. Alternative explanation – for those who consider me as all types of relatives, I too consider them the same way.
- *uṟṟār ili* – Did the amazing [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who has never been attained by any one on his/her own effort until now, enter her?
- *uṟṟīrgaḷ* … – When told “Why are you doubting like this? Why don’t you explain clearly to the relatives?”, [parānguśa nāyaki](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/)‘s mother says “Shall I simply say because you are relatives? Should there not be something to say? How can I explain this?”.

They ask, “Why are you saying like this?”, she says,

- *uṟṟu* … – My very young daughter have clearly understood about emperumān and is speaking \[about emperumān\]; how can I, who am just in the shore, \[understand it and\] explain it? Since the divine mother mood is also a state of mind of [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) himself \[just as parānguśa nāyaki mood is also a state of mind of āḻvār\], why is she faltering to explain \[why could she not understand and explain it herself\]? As īśvaran is explained in tiruvāimoḻi 8.4.6 “*tanakkum than tanmai aṟiyān*” ([emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/) himself does not know the limits of his greatness), here āḻvār’s state cannot be understood even by herself.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.8. Uraikkinra

*uraikkinṟa mukkatpirān yānē ennum uraikkinṟa tisaimugan yānē ennum uraikkkinṟa amararum yānē ennum uraikkinṟa amararkōn yānē ennum uraikkinṟa munivarum yānē ennum uraikkinṟa mugil vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? uraikkinṟa ulagattīrkken sollugēn? uraikkinṟa en kōmaḷa oṇ kodikkē*

**Пословный перевод:**

uraikkinṟa – explained (as a form of bhagavān in “saśiva:“); mukkaṇ – three-eyed; pirān – rudran who is famously known as īśvaran; yānē – is my prakāram (form); ennum – she said; uraikkinṟa – explained (as in “sabrahmā“); tisai mugan – caturmukha (four-faced); yānē – is my form; ennum – she said; uraikkinṟa – explained (as bhagavān’s wealth, as in “dakśādaya:“); amararum – dēvas who are the ten prajāpatis (progenitors); yānē – are my forms; ennum – she said; uraikkinṟa – explained (as in “sēndra:“); amarar kōn – indra (who is the lord of thirty three crore dēvatās); yānē – is my form; ennum – she said; uraikkinṟa – explained (as in “dēvariśīṇām ca nārada:“); munivarum – riśis (sages); yānē – are at my disposal; ennum – she said; uraikkinṟa – explained (in vēdāntams as in “neela tōyata madyastā“); mugil – dark like a black cloud; vaṇṇan – one who is having a form; ēṟak kolō – is this how he has entered her?; uraikkinṟa – who are telling (“tell us” repeatedly); ulagattīrkku – you who are part of this world; uraikkinṟa – who is not speaking according to the limits of this world; en – my; kōmaḷam – tender; oṇ – attractive; kodikku – for my daughter who is like a creeper which falls on the ground, when there is no support; ivai – these qualities; en – what; sollugēn – shall I say?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “the three-eyed rudran, who is explained in śāstram and is famously known as īśvaran, is my prakāram (form)”; she said “caturmukha who is explained in śāstram is my form”; she said “the dēvas who are explained in śāstram and are the ten progenitors are my forms”; she said “indra who is explained in śāstram is my form”; she said “the riśis who are explained in śāstram are at my disposal”; is this how he, who is explained in śāstram and is having a black-cloud like dark form entered her? What shall I say about the qualities of my tender attractive daughter who is not speaking according to the limits of this world and is like a creeper which falls on the ground, when there is no support, to you who are all all part of this world?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the eighth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter says that brahmā et al who are explained as primary deities of the universe in śāstram, are at her disposal”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. uraikkinṟa mukkatpirān yānē ennum uraikkinṟa tisaimugan yānē ennum uraikkkinṟa amararum yānē ennum uraikkinṟa amararkōn yānē ennum uraikkinṟa munivarum yānē ennum uraikkinṟa mugil vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? uraikkinṟa ulagattīrkken sollugēn? uraikkinṟa en kōmaḷa oṇ kodikkē*

- *uraikkinṟa mukkatpirān* … – My daughter is saying – rudran who is explained in portions of vēdam where [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s wealth is elaborately explained, in portions where simple glorifications are present as well as in tāmasa purāṇams (the purāṇams in the mode of ignorance), and who helps his own group, is at my disposal. Alternative explanation – He is explained as a prakāram (form) for īśvara (bhagavān) as said in [śrī bhagavat gītā 10.23](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/10-23/) “*rudrāṇām śankaraścāsmi*” (I am Sankara among the rudras).
- *uraikkinṟa tisai mugan …* – She said – as said in sāma vēdam “*virūpākśāya brahmaṇa: putrāya jyēśtāya śrēśtāya*” (the first and best son of brahmā, with deformed eyes), brahmā who is popularly known through vēdam as the father of such rudra is also at my disposal.
- *amarar* – She said – the ten primary progenitors, who were created by brahmā, and are explained in śāstram as those who are responsible for routine creation related activities are all at my disposal.
- *uraikkinṟa amarar* … – Also means that, as said in “*brahmadakśādaya:*” (brahmā, dakśa et al), those progenitors who are forms of [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/).
- *uraikkinṟa amarar kōn …* – Saying that she is indra as said in rig vēdam “*nakirindravaduttara:*” (Oh indra! there is none superior to you). Also said as the one who is explained as a form of bhagavān as said in [śrī bhagavat gītā 10.22](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/10-22/) “*dēvānāmasmi vāsava:*” (I am indra among dēvas).
- *munivarum …* – She said – those manu et al who meditate upon the meanings of vēdam and instruct what is to be done by those residents of the universe, are at my disposal.
- *mugil vaṇṇan* … – As said in “*neela tōyata madyastā*” (like a lightning amidst a dark cloud). Did sarvēśvara who appears like a laden dark cloud which absorbed the water, making huge sound and lights, and who is having a beautiful form, enter her?
- *uraikkinṟa ulagattīrkku* – What shall I say to you worldly people who do not discriminate between what can be expressed and cannot be, and keep insisting to answer you?
- *uraikkinṟa ulagattīrkku* – Had she mercifully not spoken I would have explained about her. “*kōmaḷam”* indicates her tender nature. “*kodi*” indicates her \[tender\] age where she does not sustain herself without a proper support just as a creeper does not stand on its own as said in śrī rāmāyaṇam ayōdyā kāṇḍam 118.34 “*pati samyōga sulabham vaya:*” (Seeing my age which is apt to get married to a man).

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.9. Kodiya vinai

*kodiya vinai yādum ilanē ennum kodiya vinai āvēnum yānē ennum kodiya vinai seyvēnum yānē ennum kodiya vinai tīrppēnum yānē ennum kodiyān ilangai seṟṟēnē ennum kodiya puḷ udaiyavan ēṟak kolō? kodiya ulagattīrkkivai en sollugēn? kodiyēn kodi en magaḷ kōlangaḷē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kodiya – having cruelty (to torture the badda cētanas (bound souls) who are bound by their karma); vinai – karma (action – virtue/vice); yādum – any; ilan – I don’t have; ennum – she said; kodiya vinai – that; āvēnum – one who becomes; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kodiya vinai – engaging them in those karmas; seyvēnum – make them perform; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kodiya vinai – that karma; tīrppēnum – one who removes for the devotees; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kodiyān – the cruel person, rāvaṇa – his; ilangai – lankā; seṟṟēn – I destroyed; ennum – she said; kodiya – cruel like death (for the enemies of devotees); puḷ – periya tiruvadi (garudāḻvār); udaiyavan – one who has as vehicle; ēṟak kolō – is this how he entered her?; kodiya – having cruelty (of very much forcing instead of remaining “this cannot be understood by us”); ulagattīrkku – people of this world; kodiyēn – experiencing cruelty (of the sins which made me witness my disturbed daughter); en – my; kodi – creeper like very slim girl; magaḷ – daughter’s; kōlangaḷ – attractive pastimes; ivai – these; en – what; sollugēn – shall I say?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “I don’t have any cruel karma \[which affects me\]”; she said “I am the one who becomes those cruel karmas”; she said “I engage them in those karmas and make them perform the same”; she said “I am the one who removes that karma from the devotees”; she said “I destroyed lankā of cruel rāvaṇa”; is this how emperumān who has death-like cruel garudāḻvār as his vehicle, entered her?”; Oh people of this cruel world! What shall I who am experiencing cruelty, say about the attractive pastimes of my creeper-like very slim daughter?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the ninth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter speaks bhagavān‘s words starting with his not being affected by any karma, as her own words”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter said that all cruel karmas are at my disposal”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kodiya vinai yādum ilanē ennum kodiya vinai āvēnum yānē ennum kodiya vinai seyvēnum yānē ennum kodiya vinai tīrppēnum yānē ennum kodiyān ilangai seṟṟēnē ennum kodiya puḷ udaiyavan ēṟak kolō? kodiya ulagattīrkkivai en sollugēn? kodiyēn kodi en magaḷ kōlangaḷē*

- *kodiya vinai yādum ilanē ennum* – My daughter said – I do not have karmas which mercilessly torture bound souls. She is reciting the same which is explained as [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s nature in rig vēdam “*anaśnannanyō abhiśākaśīti*” (paramātmā who is different from jīvātmā is shining radiantly due to not experiencing the results of actions) and in [śrī bhagavat gītā 4.14](http://githa.koyil.org/index.php/4-14/) “*na mām karmāṇi limpanti*” (I am neither affected by the results of karma nor I am attached to them). Whatever is explained in tiruvāimoḻi 7.5.2 “*nāttil piṟandu padādan pattu*” (being born in this material realm and going through sufferings), is based on his voluntary pursuit.
- *āvēnum …* – She said – Not that I am unaffected by these, am I separate from them \[sinful acts\]? Those sins are nothing but my anger/displeasure.
- *seyvēnum* … – She said – I am the one who creates these sins in those who are inimical towards devotees. seygai indicates his engaging the enemies of his devotees into sinful acts \[to facilitate their downfall\]. śrī bhagavat gītā 16.19 “*tānaham dviśta: krūrān*” (I push those evil persons into demoniac births).
- *tīrppēnum* – She said – I am the one who declares as in śrī bhagavat gītā 18.66 “*sarvapāpēbhyō mōkśayiśyāmi*” (I will relieve you from all sins), to have them not affect those who are surrendered to me.
- *kodiyān ilangai seṟṟēnē ennum* – nanjīyar mercifully explained the usage of the word “*kodiyān*” (the cruel person) as done by the divine mother of [parānguśa nāyaki](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/), since emperumān himself did not consider him as a worthy enemy \[so he did not describe him as cruel\]; since parānguśa nāyaki is possessed by him, she too would not say like that. periya tirumoḻi 5.7.7 “*surikuḻal kanivāyt tiruvinaip piritta kodumaiyil kaduvisai arakkan*” (the evil minded demon who separated pirātti who has beautiful hairs and reddish lips).
- *kodiya puḷ* … – Did [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who has periya tiruvadi (garudāḻvār) who is like death personified for the enemies of emperumān’s devotees, enter her?
   - *kodiya ulagattīrkku …* – Two explanations – 1) the people of this world who have gathered around to hear \[about her daughter\]; 2) those who are self-centered in asking her to explain without understanding whether the situation can be explained or not.  What shall I tell you?
- *kodiyēn …* – I who have committed sins to hear words said by my daughter who is imitating emperumān. \[kōlangaḷē\] the actions of my daughter; the efforts of my daughter.

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.10. Kolam kol

*kōlam koḷ suvarggamum yānē ennum kōlam il naragamum yānē ennum kōlam tigaḻ mōkkamum yānē ennum kōlam koḷ uyirgaḷum yānē ennum kōlam koḷ tani mudal yānē ennum kōlam koḷ mugil vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? kōlam koḷ ulagattīrkken sollugēn? kōlam tigaḻ kōdai en kūndalukkē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kōlam – enjoyability (in being attractive); koḷ – having; suvarggamum – svargam (heaven); yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; kōlam – having special features; il – not; naragamum – narakam (hell, which has great sorrow); yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; kōlam – due to distinguished form (of unlimited bliss); tigaḻ – shining; mōkkamum – mōkśam \[paramapadam, the spiritual realm\]; yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; kōlam – these results; koḷ – putting efforts to attain; uyirgaḷum – creatures; yānē – at my disposal; ennum – she said; kōlam – controlling all of these through his mind; koḷ – having; tani – not expecting help from anyone else; mudal – the supreme causal entity; yānē – I am; ennum – she said; kōlam – fresh form, shining lightning and multi-coloured rainbow; koḷ – having; mugil – cloud like; vaṇṇan – one who is having a form; ēṟak kolō – is this how he entered her?; kōlam koḷ – being fixed on “we will not leave until we hear”; ulagattīrkku – for you all; kōlam – beauty; tigaḻ – shining; kōdai – having garland; en kūndalukku – for my daughter who is having locks of hair; en – in what manner it was; sollugēn – how can I say?

**Перевод:**

**My daughter said “enjoyable svargam is at my disposal”; she said “narakam which is not having special features is at my disposal”; she said “mōkśam which is shining due to its distinguished form is at my disposal”; she said “all creatures which are putting efforts to attain these aforementioned results are at my disposal”; she said “I am the supreme causal entity who does not expect any help from anyone to control all of these through my mind”; Is this how emperumān who is having form resembling a cloud which is having a fresh form, shining lightning and multi-coloured rainbow, entered her? How can I say to you all who are being fixed on “we will not leave until we hear”, the manner it \[this experience\] was for my daughter who is having beautiful shining locks of hair with garland?**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the tenth pāsuram, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter said that all entities such as svargam (heaven) etc are all at her disposal”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, parānguśa nāyaki‘s mother says “My daughter said that all results such as svargam (heaven), naraka (hell) etc are at her disposal”.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kōlam koḷ suvarggamum yānē ennum kōlam il naragamum yānē ennum kōlam tigaḻ mōkkamum yānē ennum kōlam koḷ uyirgaḷum yānē ennum kōlam koḷ tani mudal yānē ennum kōlam koḷ mugil vaṇṇan ēṟak kolō? kōlam koḷ ulagattīrkken sollugēn? kōlam tigaḻ kōdai en kūndalukkē*

- *kōlam koḷ …* – svarga which is an abode of pleasure. Since it is impermanent \[as being part of the material realm\], the pleasure factor explained here is based on the superficial attractive nature of it. nanjīyar mercifully explained “See, though svargam is similar to narakam, the entrance will be nicely decorated”.
- *kōlam il* … – She is saying narakam which does not have anything which makes us believe that it is joyful unlike svargam which misleads us to make us believe about \[fake\] joy \[i.e., narakam has pure sorrow without even a trace of joy\], is at her disposal.
- *mōkkamum* … – She said “mōkśam \[paramapadam\], from where there is no return, is also at my disposal”. She said “all of these aspects starting with sruśti (creation) as said in the 1st pāsuram “*kadal jñālam seydēn*” upto mōkśam (liberation), are all my own actions”.
- *kōlam koḷ uyirgaḷum* … – Like those who arrange stage-plays, assuming the forms of dēva (celestial being), manuśya (human); the [jīvātmās](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/06/thathva-thrayam-chith-who-am-i/) who assume these variegated forms \[they are all at my disposal\]; alternative explanation – jīvātmās who are identified by their jñānam (knowledge) and ānandam (bliss).
- *kōlam koḷ tani mudal …* – Identifying the [mūla prakruti](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/09/thathva-thrayam-achith-what-is-matter/) (primordial matter) which is the cause for everything mentioned here, or identifying the sankalpa rūpa jñānam (knowledge in the form of his will) \[of [bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)\]. That is, [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/) who is filled with all auspicious qualities, and having [prakruti](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/09/thathva-thrayam-achith-what-is-matter/) which is the cause for variegated effects and sankalpa rūpa jñānam, as his prakāram (attributes, forms).
- *kōlam koḷ mugil vaṇṇan …* – When citing the cloud as an example for [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)‘s divine form, the cloud should first be decorated \[to try and match his beauty\]. Cloud can be compared to his divine form only when it shining with lightning, roaring with thunder and is having a rainbow.
- *kōlam koḷ ulagattīrkku* … – For you all, who are fixated in hearing about my daughter. Alternative explanation – you all \[materialistic people\] who have groomed your hair and nails, and have your bodies decorated. What can I say to you all?
- *kōlam …* – The emotions which occurred in my daughter who is having beautiful hair and garland. What can I say about my daughter who torments those who saw her beautiful hair and garland, herself being tormented here?

In the next article we will enjoy the next pāsuram.

## 5.6.11. Kundal malar mangaikkum

*kūndal malar mangaikkum maṇ madandaikkum kula āyar koḻundukkum kēḷvan tannai vāynda vaḻudi vaḷa nādan mannu kurugūrc catakōpan kuṟṟēval seydu āynda tamiḻ mālai āyirattuḷ ivaiyum oru pattum vallār ulagil ēndu perum selvattarāyt tirumāl adiyārgaḷaip pūsikka nōṟṟārgaḷē*

**Пословный перевод:**

kūndal – having distinguished hair (as said in tiruvāimoḻi 10.10.2 “vāsam sey pūm kuḻalāḷ“); malar – being infinitely enjoyable due to having been born in the lotus flower; mangaikkum – for lakshmi (who is ever youthful); maṇ madandaikkum – for śrī bhūmip pirātti (who is as distinguished in her beauty etc as śrī mahālakśmi); kulam – having high family heritage; āyar – for covherd clan; koḻundukkum – for nappinnaip pirātti (who is like a crown jewel); kēḷvan tannai – towards sarvēśvaran who is very dear; vāynda – due to overwhelming emotions, having attained the mood of bhagavān; vaḻudi vaḷa nādan – leader of vaḻudi vaḷa nādu (region covering āḻvārtirunagari); mannu – firmly placed; kurugūr – leader of āḻvārtirunagari; satakōpan – nammāḻvār; kuṟṟēval – as confidential service; seydu – performed; āynda – spoken after analysis; tamiḻ mālai – garland in tamiḻ; āyirattuḷ – among the thousand pāsurams; ivaiyum oru pattum – this distinguished decad which is hailed as “what a decad is this!”; vallār – those who can meditate upon (with the same emotions); ulagil – in this world; ēndu – to be held high; perum selvattarāy – having the great wealth of śrīvaiṣṇavaśrī; tirumāl – for sarvēśvaran who is śriya:pati (lord of śrī mahālakśmi); adiyārgaḷai – bhāgavatas who are servitors; pūsikka – to worship; nōṟṟārgaḷ – fortunate to do

**Перевод:**

**nammāḻvār, the leader of āḻvārtirunagari which is part of vaḻudi vaḷa nādu (a region covering āḻvārtirunagari), due to overwhelming emotions, having attained the mood of bhagavān, spoke after analysis, this distinguished decad.  This is hailed as “what a decad is this!” among the thousand pāsurams , which is on sarvēśvaran who is very dear to lakshmi who is infinitely enjoyable having been born in lotus flower and who is having distinguished hair, to śrī bhūmip pirātti and to nappinnai pirātti who is the crown jewel of the covherd clan which has high family heritage. Those who can meditate upon this decad, will be held high in this world, having the great wealth of śrīvaiṣṇavaśrī and be fortunate to worship bhāgavatas who are servitors of sarvēśvaran who is śriya:pati.**

**Комментарий. Автор Tirukkurugaippiran Piḷḷān:**

*No specific introduction.*

See [vādi kēsari aḻagiya maṇavāḷa jīyar](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/vadhi-kesari-azhagiya-manavala-jiyar/)‘s translation.

**Комментарий. Автор Nañjīyar:**

*In the end pāsuram, āḻvār says “Those who are well versed in this decad, will serve śrīvaiṣṇavas”.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Vādhi Kēsari Azhagiya Maṇavāḷa Jīyar:**

*Subsequently, āḻvār explains being honoured by the whole world and being specifically born to serve bhāgavatas, as the result of those who learn this decad.*

**Комментарий. Автор Periyavāccān Piḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction.*

See [nampiḷḷai](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nampillai/)‘s vyākhyānam.

**Комментарий. Автор Nampiḷḷai:**

*See nanjīyar‘s introduction. kūndal malar mangaikkum maṇ madandaikkum kula āyar koḻundukkum kēḷvan tannai vāynda vaḻudi vaḷa nādan mannu kurugūrc catakōpan kuṟṟēval seydu āynda tamiḻ mālai āyirattuḷ ivaiyum oru pattum vallār ulagil ēndu perum selvattarāyt tirumāl adiyārgaḷaip pūsikka nōṟṟārgaḷē*

- *kūndal malar mangaikkum …* – periya pirāttiyār who is the reason for [sarvēśvaran](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/)‘s wealth. periya pirāttiyār who is the wealth of sarvēśvaran as said in śrīviṣṇu purāṇam 1.8.17 “one who is the wealth of viṣṇu”. śrī bhūmip pirātti who is the land on which such wealth grows \[since she is considered as mother earth, here she is celebrated in this manner\]. nappinnaip pirātti (śrī nīḷā dēvi) who is the resulting enjoyment of such wealth. “*śriyā sārdam jagat pati:*” ([bhagavān](https://granthams.koyil.org/2013/03/12/thathva-thrayam-iswara-who-is-god/), the lord of the universe, is graciously seated in śrīvaikuṇṭam along with lakśmī \[includes bhūmi dēvi and nīḷā dēvi\]).
- *kēḷvan tannai* – bhagavān who is the lord of these divine consorts. From this, we can understand that [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) is not just enacting a particular avatāram (incarnation) of [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/), but is enacting the complete lord of ubhaya vibhūti (spiritual and material realm).
- *vāynda* – vāykkai – attaining. Implying about attainment of this aspect of enacting [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/).
- *kuṟṟēval seydu* – Recital of these pāsurams are the confidential service of [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) at the divine feet of emperumān. Service rendered in the form of speech. How can this enacting be considered as a service? If the lord who accepts it, considers it as service, what is inappropriate in considering so? His pleasure is the goal of our service. emperumān will feel greatly joyful thinking “In this samsāram (material realm), there is some one who enacts my pastimes and sustains himself during separation from me”, and hence that will be considered as service to him.
- *āynda tamiḻ mālai …* – Those who can practice this decad among the thousand pāsurams in the form of a garland, which were spoken after analysis.
- *ulagil ēndu perum selvattarāy* – Having śrīvaiṣṇavaśrī (wealth of kainkaryam) and be celebrated in this world itself by the people of this world. Alternative explanation – like a pot which keeps rising up from the well while fetching water, having infinite wealth in this world as said in perumāḷ tirumoḻi 5.9 “*ninnaiyētān vēṇḍi nīḷ selvam tān vēṇḍādān tannaiyē tān vēṇḍum selvam*” (the wealth which willingly reaches the one who desires no other wealth than [emperumān](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/)).
- *tirumāl adiyārgaḷaip pūsikka nōṟṟārgaḷē* – They will get to worship \[serve\] the divine children of [śrīmahālakśmi](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sri-mahalakshmi/) and [śrīman nārāyaṇan](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/sriman-narayanan/).  Worśipping the devotees of śriya:pati means – just as [āḻvār](http://acharyas.koyil.org/index.php/nammazhwar/) became dear to śrīvaiṣṇavas by his enacting of emperumān, those who learn this decad will also engage in activities that please śrīvaiṣṇavas. That is – reciting these pāsurams. āḻvār himself said in tiruvāimoḻi 9.4.9 “*toṇḍarkkamuduṇṇac col mālaigaḷ sonnēn*” (I recited these garlands of words, to have the devotees drink them as nectar).
